* Bachelor's Degree AND extensive experience in datacenter engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience

Title: Sr Engagement Manager | Gestionnaire senior de l'engagement, Public Sector Professional Services | Services professionnels du secteur public
Description:
**Description**
Do you have a deep passion for utilizing technology to empower businesses? Would you like to have a career that supports customers and partners reach their outcomes faster and cheaper through Cloud Services?
  
  
We are hiring a Senior Engagement Manager capable of leading internal AWS, external partners, and customer teams to deliver AWS cloud products and services that enable our customers to realize their business outcomes. You will need to draw on your customer-facing skills and technical acumen to understand customer requirements and enable them to implement their digital transformation projects.
  
  
You will be collaborating with many stakeholder groups to support requirements gathering and scope definition. You will be working on an ongoing basis to proactively implement best practices for our customers and help identify and close project gaps working with all levels of organizations. Typical engagements include: Cloud Strategy and Business Case Development, Cloud Suitability and Migration Assessments, Cloud Architecture Design and Implementation, On-Premise to Cloud Migrations, and Cloud Organizational Alignment.
  
  
Avez-vous une passion profonde pour l'utilisation de la technologie afin d'outiller les entreprises? Aimeriez-vous poursuivre une carrière qui aide les clients et les partenaires à atteindre leurs objectifs plus rapidement et à moindre coût grâce aux services infonuagiques?
  
  
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) gestionnaire principal(e) de l'engagement capable de diriger des équipes internes d'AWS, des partenaires externes et des équipes clients afin de livrer des produits et services infonuagiques AWS qui permettent à nos clients de réaliser leurs objectifs d'affaires. Vous devrez mettre à profit vos compétences en relation client et votre sens technique pour comprendre les exigences des clients et les accompagner dans la mise en œuvre de leurs projets de transformation numérique.
  
  
Vous collaborerez avec de nombreux groupes d'intervenants pour soutenir la collecte des exigences et la définition de la portée des projets. Vous travaillerez de façon continue à mettre en œuvre de manière proactive les pratiques exemplaires pour nos clients et à cerner et combler les lacunes des projets en collaboration avec tous les échelons des organisations. Les mandats typiques comprennent : l'élaboration de stratégies infonuagiques et d'analyses de rentabilité, les évaluations d'admissibilité et de migration vers l'infonuagique, la conception et la mise en œuvre d'architectures infonuagiques, les migrations de l'infrastructure sur site vers l'infonuagique, ainsi que l'harmonisation organisationnelle liée à l'infonuagique.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Delivery
  
  

* Collaborate with AWS field sales, pre-sales, training, and support teams to seek to understand our customers’ needs, their business, how success is defined, and ensure that we are exceeding expectations in developing and delivering customer outcomes.
* Plan, organize, and manage all phases of the project lifecycle to ensure successful delivery. This includes developing and managing project governance plans, project schedules, team goals, project milestones, budgets and defining success criteria.
* Manage engagement goals and lead teams to achieve customers’ business outcomes by managing issues, risks, decisions, dependencies, and action items.
* Work with stakeholders and AWS sales teams to amend the contractual scope, financials, and expected timelines
* Ability to take ownership, work under pressure, stay within budget, and meet deadlines
* Hold internal and external teams accountable, redirect when needed, and manage customer expectations throughout engagements.
* Works effectively in a dynamic environment with changing priorities and able to take proactive steps to ensure teams meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Ability to be self-directed and effective working independently, yet equally comfortable contributing in a global team environment
* Results-oriented, prioritizes work activities, plans and stays organized in order to meet commitments.
* Ensures AWS and Partner teams meet or exceed customer business objectives

Solutions
  
  

* Lead individuals, teams, or multiple groups and play an active role in analyzing project goals, creating a plan to achieve those goals, and then guiding AWS team members, customer stakeholders/SMEs and potentially other third parties to achieve those goals while understanding the client environment and any limitations to execution.
* Actively looks for ways to improve process efficiencies and effectiveness.
* Ability to apply strategic thinking and demonstrate understanding of requirements to execute.
* Ability to make decisions guided by policies, procedures and business plans with limited guidance.
* Ability to apply business and financial acumen to achieve measurable business results for customer success.
* Support and influence the sales lifecycle by engaging clients in defining next phases of cloud projects as appropriate to meet client needs.
* Participate in practice development by contributing to the development of practical solutions and methodologies, and the development of knowledge sharing artifacts.

Communication
  
  

* Excellent written, verbal communication, and presentation skills with team members and audiences of all levels.
* Ability to build relationships with various customer and internal AWS stakeholders which consists of senior leadership teams (C-level execs, SVP/VP, Directors) and project level resources such as SMEs.
* Plans and oversees the preparation and distribution of project communications.
* Understand the operating styles of others as well as team/client relationships, team dynamics, and adjusts behavior accordingly to succeed. Recognizes environmental or cultural nuances and adapts.
* Foster an inclusive and diverse work environment.

Team Work
  
  

* Proven success in working with teams and executive leadership in a complex customer environment.
* Team player who effectively integrates, motivates and builds relationships with cross-functional team members (local or remote), sponsors, key stakeholders, executives, and other individuals or organizations involved with or affected by the project.
* Proven experience working in a matrix environment, managing multiple stakeholders.
* Excellent people management skills, including the ability to influence, negotiate and achieve results through others who are not direct reports.

This is a customer-facing role. You may be required to travel to customer locations to deliver professional services when needed when travel resumes. We offer a flexible work environment to help you balance your work and personal life, while still remaining customer obsessed.
  
  
Livraison
  
  

* Collaborer avec les équipes de vente, d'avant-vente, de formation et de soutien d'AWS sur le terrain afin de chercher à comprendre les besoins de nos clients, leur entreprise, la façon dont le succès est défini, et veiller à ce que nous dépassions les attentes en matière de développement et de livraison des résultats clients.

Cela comprend l'élaboration et la gestion de plans de gouvernance de projet, de calendriers de projet, d'objectifs d'équipe, de jalons de projet, de budgets et la définition de critères de succès.
* Gérer les objectifs des mandats et diriger les équipes afin d'atteindre les résultats d'affaires des clients en gérant les enjeux, les risques, les décisions, les dépendances et les mesures à prendre.
* Travailler avec les intervenants et les équipes de vente d'AWS pour modifier la portée contractuelle, les aspects financiers et les échéanciers prévus.
* Capacité à prendre en charge les responsabilités, à travailler sous pression, à respecter les budgets et les échéances.
* Tenir les équipes internes et externes responsables, réorienter au besoin et gérer les attentes des clients tout au long des mandats.
* Travailler efficacement dans un environnement dynamique où les priorités changent et être en mesure de prendre des mesures proactives pour s'assurer que les équipes répondent aux attentes des clients ou les dépassent.
* Capacité à travailler de façon autonome et efficace de manière indépendante, tout en étant également à l'aise de contribuer au sein d'une équipe mondiale.
* Axé(e) sur les résultats, priorise les activités de travail, planifie et demeure organisé(e) afin de respecter les engagements.
* S'assurer que les équipes d'AWS et des partenaires atteignent ou dépassent les objectifs d'affaires des clients.

Solutions
  
  

* Diriger des individus, des équipes ou plusieurs groupes et jouer un rôle actif dans l'analyse des objectifs de projet, la création d'un plan pour atteindre ces objectifs, puis guider les membres de l'équipe AWS, les intervenants/experts en la matière du client et potentiellement d'autres tiers pour atteindre ces objectifs, tout en comprenant l'environnement du client et les contraintes liées à l'exécution.
* Rechercher activement des moyens d'améliorer l'efficacité et l'efficience des processus.
* Capacité à appliquer une réflexion stratégique et à démontrer une compréhension des exigences pour mener à bien l'exécution.
* Capacité à prendre des décisions guidées par les politiques, les procédures et les plans d'affaires avec un encadrement limité.
* Capacité à appliquer un sens des affaires et des finances pour obtenir des résultats d'affaires mesurables favorisant le succès des clients.
* Soutenir et influencer le cycle de vente en mobilisant les clients dans la définition des prochaines phases des projets infonuagiques, selon les besoins des clients.
* Participer au développement de la pratique en contribuant à l'élaboration de solutions et de méthodologies concrètes, ainsi qu'au développement d'outils de partage des connaissances.

Communication
  
  

* Excellentes compétences en communication écrite, verbale et en présentation avec les membres de l'équipe et les auditoires de tous les niveaux.
* Capacité à établir des relations avec divers intervenants internes d'AWS et clients, y compris les équipes de haute direction (cadres de niveau C, PVP principal/VP, directeurs) ainsi que les ressources au niveau des projets telles que les experts en la matière.
* Planifier et superviser la préparation et la distribution des communications de projet.

* Favoriser un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié.

Travail d'équipe
  
  

* Succès démontré dans le travail avec des équipes et la haute direction dans un environnement client complexe.
* Esprit d'équipe qui intègre efficacement, motive et établit des relations avec les membres d'équipes interfonctionnelles (locaux ou à distance), les commanditaires, les intervenants clés, les cadres et les autres personnes ou organisations touchées par le projet.
* Expérience avérée de travail dans un environnement matriciel, gérant de multiples intervenants.
* Excellentes compétences en gestion des personnes, y compris la capacité d'influencer, de négocier et d'obtenir des résultats par l'entremise d'autres personnes qui ne sont pas des subordonnés directs.

Title: Senior Customer Success Manager (Transformation Advisor), Independent Software Vendor (ISV)
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Canada is looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) team, a role at the intersection of technology strategy, business transformation, and customer partnership.  
  
You will own the success of a portfolio of Canadian ISVs navigating multi-year cloud, SaaS, and AI transformation journeys. Your job is to ensure these companies don't just adopt AWS; they build competitive advantage on it. That means helping them migrate critical workloads, accelerate AI and agentic capability adoption, and translate their technology investments into measurable business outcomes.  
  
In this role you are connecting ISV customers to the right AWS expertise, programs, and teams at the right time, and holding the thread across complex, multi-stakeholder environments.  
  
If you thrive where technical depth and business strategy intersect, and you want your work to have visible, lasting impact on how Canada's most innovative software companies grow, then this role is for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Drive Customer Outcomes  

* Own the success of a portfolio of ISV accounts, working backwards from each customer's strategic milestones to define and execute a clear path to value realization
* Lead roadmap-to-outcome alignment sessions,
* Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live milestones that accelerate each customer's cloud and AI journey
* Help ISVs build the governance, operating models, and data infrastructure needed to sustain long-term transformation, not just hit short-term milestones
* Support customers in adopting generative AI and agentic capabilities that are reshaping how software is built, delivered, and monetized

  
Orchestrate Across AWS  

* Serve as the connective tissue between ISV customers and AWS teams (Sales, Solutions Architecture, Support, Professional Services, and Partner teams) ensuring coordinated, high-quality engagement
* Contribute to account planning, translating strategic goals into executable actions with clear ownership and timelines
* Identify and remove systemic barriers that slow customer progress, escalating with precision and urgency when needed

  
Lead Strategic Engagements  

* Lead director-level engagements, co-innovation workshops, and strategic planning sessions with Product, Engineering, and Technology leadership within ISV accounts
* Help translate complex AI and cloud solutions into business cases for senior stakeholders, bridging the gap between technical teams and executive decision-makers
* Support customers through critical decision points: workload migration sequencing, AI adoption strategy, SaaS architecture evolution

  
Manage with Rigor  

* Maintain structured cadence through reporting, tracking, and health monitoring across your portfolio
* Apply structured delivery mechanisms and measurement frameworks to ensure customers realize the value of their AWS investment
* Proactively identify risks (technical, organizational, or commercial) and drive mitigation plans before they become escalations

  
Raise the Bar Internally

Description:

This role owns the translation layer between commercial priorities and network build/enablement execution, ensuring that sales commitments, market opportunities, and customer experience goals are matched to realistic, well-sequenced network capacity and infrastructure delivery.

This person is equally comfortable in a sales strategy conversation and a network engineering status review, and can move fluidly between the two, converting business urgency into engineering-ready requirements, and converting network constraints into sales-ready guidance.

* **Serve as the primary liaison** between VEC leadership and Network Project Management/Engineering teams, ensuring both sides operate from a shared view of priorities, timelines, and constraints.

* A degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or an MBA.
* Excellent executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders both inside and outside the company.
* Comfort working in ambiguity and moving quickly from idea to pilot to scaled program.

40

Title: Partner Account Executive

The role will drive the adoption and execution of the Splunk MSP Program and ensure that Splunk is embedded or “designed in” within partners’ managed security, observability, infrastructure, and digital-resilience service offerings.
  
The MSP Sales& Go-to-Market Lead does not own or manage the partner relationship. Partner ownership and accountability remain with the respective Partner Development Manager (PDM) or Partner Sales Manager (PSM). This role provides MSP expertise, direction, and execution support to help partner and sales teams build and scale successful MSP motions.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
Regional MSP Strategy and Go-to-Market
  
  

* Develop and execute the regional MSP sales and go-to-market plan, aligned with the overall EMEA MSP strategy and regional business priorities.
* Ensure that priority partners have a clear MSP strategy and execution plan embedded within the broader partner plans owned by the respective PDMs and PSMs.
* Support PDMs and PSMs in defining MSP growth plans, revenue ambitions, enablement requirements, service-development priorities, and joint go-to-market activities.
* Build a clear scale plan to expand the regional MSP ecosystem by onboarding new partners, growing existing MSP capabilities, and driving new customer acquisition.
* Identify priority markets, customer segments, industry verticals, and MSP propositions with the strongest potential for scalable growth.
* Maintain a strong understanding of regional market dynamics, competition, regulation, customer demand, and emerging managed-service trends.

Sales and Business Development
  
  

* Support and drive MSP-related sales and business development activities across the region in close collaboration with PDMs, PSMs, and Splunk sales teams.
* Develop campaigns and initiatives that create MSP pipeline, generate net-new logos, and support recurring-revenue growth.
* Maintain visibility of the regional MSP pipeline and regularly review progress, performance, and execution with sales and partner teams.
* Support joint account planning and opportunity development with key strategic MSP partners.
* Work closely with regional and global MSP sales teams to align priorities, share best practices, and accelerate strategic opportunities.
* Support complex MSP opportunities and collaborate with the EMEA team to remove commercial, operational, contractual, or organizational barriers.
* Ensure that partner ownership, execution accountability, and opportunity follow-up remain clearly assigned to the relevant PDM, PSM, and sales teams.

Splunk MSP Program and Enablement
  
  

* Lead the regional adoption and execution of the Splunk MSP Program.
* Act as the regional MSP subject-matter expert and advocate for the program across partner and sales organizations.
* Advise internal teams and partners on MSP commercial models, pricing, contracting, licensing, and partner economics.
* Educate and enable Splunk sales, partner, and technical teams on the MSP route to market and how to position and execute the program.
* Work closely with the EMEA MSP team to identify program improvements required to address regional market needs.
* Partner closely with the MSP Partner Technical Manager (PTM) to ensure that the regional plan is technically aligned and supported by the required enablement, service-development, and delivery capabilities.

GTMDevelopmentandCross-FunctionalAlignment
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with key MSP stakeholders across executive leadership, sales, technical, service-development, operations, and marketing teams.
* Support partners in developing and launching differentiated Splunk-powered managed services.
* Help ensure that Splunk is designed into partners’ service catalogues across security, observability, infrastructure monitoring, and digital resilience.
* Support the development of partner value propositions, business cases, sales plays, campaigns, and customer-facing propositions.
* Align with Splunk Regional Sales Directors, Regional Sales Managers, AVPs, partner leadership, and other senior stakeholders.
* Work closely with PDMs, PSMs, PTMs, marketing, legal, finance, operations, and the EMEA and global MSP teams.
* Prepare and deliver MSP business reviews and updates to regional, EMEA, and partner leadership teams.

Commercial Leadership and Negotiation
  
  

* Support commercial discussions and negotiations with MSP and MSSP partners.
* Work with the EMEA MSP team, legal, finance, pricing, operations, and deal-desk teams to develop scalable and commercially viable agreements.
* Help resolve complex pricing, licensing, contractual, and route-to-market considerations.
* Apply strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills to accelerate strategic opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Extensive experience working with MSPs, MSSPs, service providers, cloud providers, or technology partners.
* Deep understanding of the regional MSP and MSSP landscape, business models, customer requirements, and competitive dynamics.
* Demonstrated success in sales, business development, partner development, or go-to-market roles.
* Proven ability to translate regional strategies into executable partner and sales plans.
* Strong understanding of recurring-revenue, consumption-based, managed-service, and partner-led business models.
* Experience developing and launching partner-led managed services or technology-based service offerings.
* Strong commercial acumen and experience supporting complex pricing, contracting, and negotiation discussions.

Picture the first product that takes a customer-facing team from "I think this customer needs something" to a delivered outcome that moves a real economic metric. That is what you will own.

You own the end-to-end experience across three phases: discovery, solution development, and interlock with engineering and business teams so the capability ships.  
  
Picture your week: you define requirements for a customer-needs intelligence tool in the morning, design a solution-development workflow with engineers in the afternoon, and review business-outcome metrics with a GTM leader the next day. Customer Needs Discovery & Intelligence  

* Own the roadmap for tools that help teams understand customer needs, aggregating signals from sales conversations, account data, technical assessments, and engagement history into actionable context

* Drive integration with existing customer data sources (CRM, account plans, support cases, usage telemetry) into a unified view of customer needs

Cross-Cutting

* Define and measure success: time-to-understand, time-to-solution, delivery velocity, solution-reuse rates, customer satisfaction, and downstream GTM impact (pipeline influenced, deals closed, workloads migrated)

Title: Manager - AI Security Platform Management
Description:
**Job Description**
The role lead the end-to-end development of our AI-powered cybersecurity platform, owning its product vision, roadmap, and delivery. Acting as Product Owner and technical lead, you will translate the needs of our security teams (threat detection, investigation, response, and risk management) into AI capabilities built on classical ML and modern LLM/agentic architectures. You will guide a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and security specialists to ship a platform that is effective, reliable, secure by design, and trusted by its users across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Product Vision & Strategy
* Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI-driven cybersecurity platform aligned with business and security objectives.
* Identify and prioritize high-value security use cases (e.g., alert triage, threat hunting, incident investigation, vulnerability prioritization, threat intelligence summarization, automated response).
* Track the AI security tooling market and inform build vs. buy vs. partner decisions.
* Product Ownership & Delivery
* Own and prioritize the product backlog; write clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria with input from SOC, threat intelligence, and risk teams.
* Lead agile ceremonies (planning, refinement, reviews) and drive iterative delivery from MVP to production at scale.
* Define and track product KPIs and OKRs (e.g., analyst time saved, mean time to detect/respond, detection precision, adoption).
* Platform Architecture & Engineering Leadership
* Lead the design and development of the platform, including:

 Data ingestion and pipelines for security telemetry (SIEM, EDR, network, cloud, and identity logs, threat intelligence feeds).
  
  
 LLM, RAG, and agentic workflows with tool calling and integrations with security tools
  
  
 Model selection, fine-tuning, and serving across self-hosted options (open-weight models).
  
  
 Model gateways, prompt management, and guardrail policies.
  
  
 MCP servers and APIs that expose platform capabilities to other teams and systems.
  
  
 Analyst-facing experiences: copilots, dashboards, and human-in-the-loop review flows.
  
  

* AI Quality, Evaluation & Reliability
* Establish evaluation pipelines and benchmarks to measure the accuracy, robustness, bias, and hallucination rate of AI outputs on real security scenarios.
* Define SLOs/SLAs and observability for the platform, including fallback strategies and human escalation paths.
* Secure-by-Design Development
* Ensure the platform itself is secure by design: threat modeling (e.g., MAESTRO, OWASP GenAI / LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS), secure CI/CD, dependency and model supply-chain checks, and policy-as-code.
* Protect the sensitive security data handled by the platform through data classification, masking, DLP, and least-privilege access.
* Validation & Red Teaming
* Partner with red teams to test the platform against prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, and agent misuse before and after each release.
* Validate platform detections and recommendations against realistic attack simulations and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
* Turn findings from testing and production incidents into backlog items and continuous product improvements.
* Governance, Compliance & Responsible AI
* Ensure the platform complies with applicable AI regulations and standards (e.g., EU AI Act, regional laws, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) and internal AI use policies.
* Define responsible AI practices for the product: transparency and explainability of recommendations, data usage, model lifecycle, and third-party AI vendor risk.
* Stakeholder & Team Leadership
* Act as the primary point of contact between security operations, engineering, business, and leadership; communicate roadmap, progress, and trade-offs.
* Lead and mentor a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and security specialists; manage vendors and partners as needed.
* Drive adoption through demos, training, and feedback loops with end users (SOC analysts, threat hunters, risk teams).

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 8–12+ years in Cybersecurity, with 3–5+ years focused on AI/ML or data platforms (can be overlapping).
* Hands-on experience with:

oCloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and their AI services.
  
  
oAt least one Agentic/GenAI stack (e.g., Transformers, LangChain/LlamaIndex, vector DBs, model gateways, MLOps platforms).
  
  

* Proven track record designing or reviewing secure architectures for:

oML pipelines, LLM/RAG systems, or agentic/automation platforms.
  
  

* Strong understanding of:

oCryptography, identity & access management, network & app security.
  
  
oData protection & privacy (PII, PHI, DPIA concepts).
  
  

* Experience working with or mapping to frameworks/standards such as:

oNIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 42001, SOC 2, OWASP Top 10 & OWASP GenAI/LLM Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK/ATLAS, CSA guidance.
  
  

* Excellent communication skills: able to translate complex AI risks into clear business and technical requirements.

Core Technical & Domain Skills
  
  

* AI/ML & GenAI fundamentals:

oModel types (LLMs, encoders, diffusion, classical ML), training/inference flows.
  
  
oData pipelines, feature stores, embeddings, vector databases.
  
  

* AI Penetration testing:

oPrompt injection, model tampering, data poisoning, output manipulation, exfiltration, shadow AI, insecure plugins/integrations.
  
  

* Platform & Infra:
* Kubernetes, containers, API gateways, secrets management, zero trust.

**Job Description** :

  

The **Technical Program Manager** will join the Project Management Office and drive a complex, multi-year strategic government program involving hardware platform NPI, concurrent software releases, private cloud infrastructure deployment, and international compliance certification. The role requires strong technical program management skills, disciplined execution, executive stakeholder management, and the ability to coordinate across Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development, Networking Software (cloud management, security, controller platforms), QA, Product Management, Manufacturing, International Compliance, and government customer teams across multiple time zones.

**Release & Program Management**

* Drive releases through development completion, QA, release readiness, and GA milestones
* Track release scope, feature readiness, must-fix defects, testing completion, and release criteria
* Lead release readiness meetings, ensuring actions, risks, dependencies, and decisions are documented
* Ensure release artifacts (release notes, technical documentation, customer guides) are completed before GA
Identify schedule risks early and drive mitigation plans with responsible teams  

  

**Hardware NPI & Manufacturing Coordination**

* Manage new hardware platform NPI program through development, manufacturing, QA verification, and GA
* Track development, firmware/image readiness, QA verification, manufacturing readiness, and GA milestones
* Ensure hardware engineering and software feature commitments remain aligned with manufacturing timeline
* Coordinate hardware-firmware-software dependencies required for platform launch
* Drive BOM finalization, manufacturing-image readiness, and ODM partner coordination to ensure hardware ships with appropriate firmware
Coordinate dependencies across Hardware Engineering, Firmware, Software teams, Manufacturing, ODM partners, and other supporting organizations  

  

**Quality & Defect Management**

* Participate in recurring defect/bug scrubs across multiple software platforms and hardware validation
* Track must-fix defects and ensure critical issues are resolved before release
* Work with Engineering and QA to prioritize defects based on release impact and schedule
* Monitor automated and manual test results; escalate failures threatening release readiness
Ensure comprehensive end-to-end testing for features spanning multiple platforms (cloud management, security, controller, networking software)  

  

**Dependency, Risk & Escalation Management**

* Maintain visibility into complex cross-functional dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams
* Proactively identify schedule, resource, technical, testing, compliance, and manufacturing risks
* Maintain centralized risk register with probability/impact assessment and mitigation tracking
* Drive owners toward resolution of blocking issues rather than simply reporting status
* Escalate unresolved risks and resource conflicts to leadership with clear impact, options, and recommended actions
* Coordinate commitments when multiple programs compete for shared Engineering or QA resources
Ensure critical dependencies have clearly defined owners, dates, and closure criteria  

  

**International Compliance & Certification Management**

* Coordinate compliance deliverables required for government product release
* Track regulatory and international compliance dependencies (FCC, CE, telecom certifications, government security requirements)
* Ensure compliance requirements and certifications do not block customer deployment
* Coordinate dependencies involving external certification bodies and ODM partners
* Track certification timelines and identify delays or blockers early
Assess and communicate release impact of delayed certifications or compliance deliverables  

  

**Program Tracking & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate program plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and status using Jira and portfolio management tools
* Use Jira epics, features, defects, and dashboards to assess program health across all workstreams
* Develop concise program status reports for PMO and executive leadership
* Clearly communicate milestone health, risks, decisions required, and leadership attention areas
* Use AI tools to generate automated reports, trend analysis, and program health dashboards
* Leverage AI-driven monitoring tools to track program metrics and flag risks proactively
* Manage program coordination and reporting across multiple time zones to support global teams and customers

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **5+ years** of experience in Technical Program Management, Project Management, or Engineering Program Management in technology organizations
* **Demonstrated experience** managing complex hardware NPI programs (design through manufacturing, QA, GA)
* **Demonstrated experience** managing concurrent software releases across multiple platforms with independent release cadences
* **Strong understanding** of software development lifecycle (development, integration, QA, defect management, release readiness, GA)
* **Strong understanding** of hardware NPI lifecycle (design, manufacturing, BOM, image readiness, production ramp, GA)
* **Experience coordinating** programs involving Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development, Software teams (cloud, security, controller), QA, Product Management, Manufacturing, Compliance, and other cross-functional organizations
* **Strong experience** managing milestones, dependencies, risks, and critical-path activities across multiple concurrent programs
* **Demonstrated ability** to drive teams toward committed dates without direct management authority
* **Experience leading** release-readiness meetings, program reviews, defect reviews, and cross-functional working sessions
* **Executive communication experience** – ability to present program status, risks, and recommendations to VP/SVP-level leadership
* **Program governance experience** – ability to establish program decision-making structures and executive steering committees
* **Strong Jira experience** including epics, features, defects, dashboards, queries, and program tracking
* **Strong written and verbal communication** skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical teams and senior leadership
* **Demonstrated ability** to recognize when a program is at risk, determine underlying cause, establish action plan, and escalate appropriately
* **Risk management experience** – ability to identify, assess, prioritize, and track mitigation of program risks
* **Ability to operate** effectively in fast-moving environment with multiple simultaneous releases and changing priorities
* **Experience managing** programs with resource support across multiple time zones
* **Ability to use various AI tools** to generate reports, analyze program data, monitor program metrics, and identify trends

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

The strongest candidate will be **execution-oriented** rather than primarily administrative. They should be able to simultaneously manage hardware NPI and multiple concurrent software releases while maintaining clear understanding of what must happen, who owns it, when it must happen, what dependencies exist, what could cascade delays, and what needs leadership attention.

* **AI adoption mindset** – Comfortable leveraging AI tools to enhance reporting, analysis, and decision-making

Title: Associate Director, Operations & Maintenance (O&M)
Description:
**Job Purpose**

Dedicated to Pactive, the Associate Director, O&M is accountable for the safe, reliable and profitable operation of Pactive's installed asset base, including solar PV, battery energy storage, LED lighting, BMS and metering, HVAC and chiller plant, EV charging and energy performance (ESCO) contracts across Aldar Group and third-party clients. The role turns O&M from a cost-to-serve activity into a recurring-revenue and margin business. It leads the O&M team and subcontractors, guarantees contractual availability, performance ratio and energy savings, protects warranties and performance guarantees, builds the remote monitoring and command-and-control capability, and grows the O&M order book through renewals, upsell and new long-term service contracts.

**Job Details**

**Roles, Responsibilities, Duties**

Associate Director, Operations & Maintenance (O&M)

* **O&M Portfolio Leadership:**
  Own the end-to-end delivery of all Pactive O&M contracts, including preventive, corrective and predictive maintenance, for solar PV (rooftop, carport and ground mount), BESS, lighting, BMS, metering, HVAC, EV chargers and energy performance contracts. Set annual maintenance plans, resource plans and budgets for each contract and ensure delivery against scope, SLA, cost and quality.
* **Asset Performance & Availability:**
  Guarantee contractual availability, performance ratio (PR), yield and response and resolution times. Lead root-cause analysis of under-performance, equipment failures and generation losses, and drive corrective actions. Track and report performance against guaranteed values and minimise liquidated damages and performance penalties.
* **Energy Savings & M&V Guarantees:**
  Working with the M&V team, ensure that energy performance and shared-savings contracts deliver verified savings in line with IPMVP and contractual guarantees. Coordinate operational changes, set-points and maintenance practices that protect and grow savings, including multi-owner and owners association portfolios.
* **Remote Monitoring & Command Centre:**
  Build and run Pactive's remote monitoring and command-and-control capability (SCADA, inverter and BMS platforms, CMMS). Define alarm management, escalation and dispatch protocols, use data analytics for predictive maintenance, and deliver live performance dashboards to clients and management.
* **Commercial Growth & Recurring Revenue:**
  Grow the O&M order book through contract renewals, scope extensions, retrofits, repowering and upsell of additional services. Support Growth & Key Accounts on O&M pricing, proposals and bids, and convert Pactive's EPC handovers into long-term O&M agreements. Develop O&M offerings for third-party and developer-owned assets, including Aldar Group and joint venture portfolios.
* **Contract, Cost & Margin Management:**
  Own the P&L of the O&M portfolio. Manage contract scope, variations, claims, invoicing milestones and collections with Commercial & Controls. Monitor cost to serve, labour productivity, spare parts consumption and subcontractor spend, and protect gross margin on every contract. Holds approval authority only within the Pactive Delegation of Authority.
* **Warranty, Spares & Subcontractor Management:**
  Manage OEM warranties and performance guarantees for modules, inverters, batteries and other critical equipment, including claims and replacements. Maintain strategic spares holdings and stock levels. Select, manage and performance-review O&M subcontractors and specialist service providers in coordination with Procurement.
* **Handover & Lifecycle Engineering:**
  Define O&M requirements at design and tender stage, and lead the acceptance of new assets from Project Delivery (punch lists, as-built documentation, testing and commissioning records, training and spares). Plan mid-life refurbishment, component replacement and end-of-life strategies for the asset base.
* **Team Leadership & Capability:**
  Lead, develop and organise the O&M managers, engineers, supervisors and technicians across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and other regions. Set clear roles, KPIs and competency frameworks, plan succession, and build technical skills in solar, storage, electrical HV/LV and building systems. Foster a culture of safety, ownership and client service.
* **Client & Stakeholder Management:**
  Act as senior O&M point of contact for key clients, asset owners, Aldar Group entities, Khidmah/FM partners and authorities (DEWA, ADDC/TAQA and other utilities). Lead periodic performance reviews, manage escalations and maintain high client satisfaction and renewal rates. Agree the boundary of services with Khidmah and other group FM providers.
* **Executive & Monthly Reporting:**
  Prepare concise executive-level reports, monthly management packs and dashboards covering asset availability and PR, energy yield and savings, SLA compliance, incidents, backlog, cost, margin, order book and renewals, key risks and agreed O&M metrics. Convert complex operational data into clear actions and recommendations.
* **Standards, Compliance & Continuous Improvement:**
  Develop and maintain O&M policies, procedures and method statements aligned with OEM requirements, IEC and applicable UAE codes and authority regulations. Maintain audit-ready maintenance records in the CMMS. Drive standardisation, digitalisation, process discipline and ISO 9001/14001/45001/55001 alignment across the portfolio.
* **Key Performance Indicators:**
  Contractual availability and PR achieved; verified energy savings against guarantee; SLA response and resolution compliance; preventive maintenance completion; zero lost-time incidents; O&M revenue growth and renewal rate; gross margin per contract; warranty claims recovered; client satisfaction scores.
* **Occupational Health, Safety & Environment:**
  Adhere to all Pactive and Khidmah HSE policies, procedures, practices and applicable legal and statutory requirements, and remain current with updates. Ensure safe systems of work for all O&M activities, including permit to work, LOTO, working at height and electrical safety, and lead incident investigation and corrective actions.
* **Information Security responsibilities:**
* Comply with Pactive and Khidmah Information Security policies,
* Be aware of and fulfill their information security responsibilities
* Ensure whoever handles sensitive company information have taken the Security Awareness Training
* Know how to report a security incident (to IT ServiceDesk or InfoSec).
* Not Disable his/her OS firewall and/or Antivirus
* Restrict use to authorized purposes, Protect access accounts, privileges and associated passwords.
* Accept accountability of his/her individual user accounts and maintain confidentiality.

**Qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Energy or Renewable Energy Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Professional engineering registration or certification (e.g. CEng, PE) and CEM, CMVP or asset management (IAM/ISO 55001) qualification is strongly preferred.
* DEWA and/or ADDC solar PV or electrical certification, NEBOSH or IOSH safety qualification, and a postgraduate business or management qualification are an advantage.

**Experience and Skills:**

**Experience:**

* Approximately 12-18 years of progressive experience in O&M, asset management or technical services, including at least 5 years leading multi-site O&M portfolios and teams.
* Proven experience operating utility-scale and/or distributed solar PV assets; experience with BESS, energy efficiency, ESCO or building systems (BMS, HVAC, lighting) is highly desirable.
* Track record of delivering contractual availability, performance ratio and energy savings guarantees, and of managing O&M contracts with SLAs and liquidated damages.
* Experience in the UAE or GCC, with working knowledge of DEWA, ADDC/TAQA and other authority requirements, net metering and grid connection rules.
* Demonstrated P&L ownership of a service or O&M business, including growth of recurring revenue through renewals and new contracts.

**Technical & Commercial Capability:**

* Strong understanding of PV, inverter, BESS and electrical HV/LV systems, monitoring platforms (SCADA, CMMS) and data-driven predictive maintenance.
* Able to interpret contract terms, cost to serve, budgets, forecasts, actuals and variances, and to price O&M scopes competitively and profitably.
* Advanced analytical capability, with confidence developing performance analytics, management information and executive reporting.

**Skills & Behaviours:**

* Inspiring, hands-on leader able to build and motivate field teams and hold subcontractors to account.
* Uncompromising commitment to safety and service quality.
* Credible with clients and senior management; strong negotiation skills.
* Excellent communication; able to distil complex technical information into concise recommendations.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint capability; experience with CMMS, SCADA/monitoring and ERP (SAP) tools is expected.
* Fluent professional English; Arabic is an advantage. Valid UAE driving licence required.

Title: Delivery Program Director
Description:
Position Overview:

We are creating a new leadership role that brings Customer Success and Product Support together under one owner.

On the Customer Success side, you will be accountable for the full client experience after contract signature, from onboarding and go live through adoption, satisfaction and renewal.

On the Support side, you will have direct responsibility for the Product Support team and overall accountability for support service excellence. This includes defining support processes, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinating with shared support and maintenance functions to ensure seamless collaboration and the delivery of reliable 24/7 customer support within SLA targets.

Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to deliver: every client should be well supported, getting real value from our products, and happy to recommend us. You will build the Customer Success function largely from the ground up, give the business a clear, data driven view of client health and raise the standard of our support operation.

The role is deliberately hands-on in the first year. Alongside building the team and the operating model, you will personally manage key customer relationships, lead critical escalations and work directly with the support team on day-to-day operations until the new processes and team are fully established.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Product Support**

* Define and run support processes covering triage, prioritization, SLAs, incident and problem management, root cause analysis and knowledge management, in close alignment with SaaS Operations and Engineering.
* Improve the speed and quality of incident and problem management, as well as how customers perceive it.
* Use monitoring, data and AI to move support from reactive to proactive, increasing self service and first contact resolution.
* Build a support model that scales with the customer base.

**Build and run the Customer Success function**

* Define and run the customer success operating model: customer segmentation and coverage, engagement playbooks, a common account plan and a customer health score.
* Set the rhythm of customer engagement, including onboarding reviews, regular service reviews, executive business reviews and renewal planning.
* Build a joint customer success model across SBS product lines and regions.

**Orchestrate the customer experience**

* Act as the single point of accountability for the customer experience across Support, Customer Success and delivery teams.
* Ensure customer experience responsiveness, predictability and transparency on incidents, releases and roadmap commitments.
* Own escalation management, personally leading critical escalations through to resolution and clear communication with the client.
* Work with Professional Services to ensure a smooth handover from project to run, so every go live lands well.

**Elevate customer satisfaction and retention**

* Run proactive health reviews and early risk detection, with clear recovery plans for accounts at risk.
* Own the voice of the customer: CSAT and NPS programs, app store ratings and structured feedback loops into Product.
* Contribute to the SBS Customer Satisfaction Program and embed the Golden Disciplines across customer-facing teams.
* Protect renewals by working with Account Managers well ahead of renewal dates, so there are no surprises.

**Maximize product adoption and realized value**

* Track usage and adoption across products and modules, and identify underused features and adoption gaps.
* Run adoption plans with customers to unlock more of the value they have already bought.
* Measure and demonstrate tangible ROI to client executives through regular value reviews.
* Bring structured customer insight into roadmap prioritization with Product Leaders.

**Surface growth opportunities**

* Identify new use cases, additional modules and upgrade opportunities within the installed base.
* Channel qualified upsell and expansion leads to Account Managers, and build a pipeline originated by the CSM team over time.

Qualifications:

* At least 10 years in enterprise software or fintech, including at least 5 years leading Customer Success, Support or Service Delivery teams.
* Strong track record in banking or financial services software, ideally in digital banking, open banking, payments or lending.
* Experience managing both SaaS and customer managed (on premise) clients, including SLA governance and major incident management.
* Credible with bank executives and comfortable leading difficult conversations when things go wrong.
* Experience across the Middle East and Africa, ideally with exposure to the US and Europe. Knowledge of the GCC banking market is a strong plus.
* Comfortable working in a matrix organization and influencing teams that do not report directly to them.
* Hands-on leader who can operate at executive level while confidently diving into the operational and technical details as required.
* Commercially astute, technically capable, and credible in banking conversations with both business and technology stakeholders.

Skills

* Operational discipline and a data driven approach to managing a client portfolio.

* Technical enough to engage with Engineering on root causes across APIs, cloud platforms and mobile applications.
* Genuine interest in using AI and automation to improve support and customer success at scale.
* Strong understanding of banking operations, banking products and the realities of running software in regulated financial institutions.
* Clear, confident communicator in writing and in person.
* Fluent English. French or Arabic is an advantage.

Education

Senior Delivery Managers are where Robots and Pencils' promise of "production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days" actually has to hold. On the engagements you run, you set the pace of delivery, the discipline behind it, and the trust that decides whether the client comes back for more. The work moves only as fast as someone is willing to own the plan, surface trade-offs early, and keep distributed teams pulling in the same direction.

**What** **You'll** **Do**

**Craft & Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-phase engagements, ensuring alignment across scope, budget, timeline, and quality to meet delivery commitments and achieve successful outcomes

* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery execution across one or more cross-functional teams

* Manage phased releases, production readiness, and transitions into operations and maintenance models

* Identify and proactively manage dependencies, risks, scope changes, and escalations before they become blockers

* Define, track, and report delivery KPIs, using data to guide decisions, manage delivery health, and inform tradeoffs across scope, timeline, and budget

* Support QA and UAT efforts, ensuring quality is validated and outcomes meet agreed acceptance criteria

* Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and stakeholder communications

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Serve as the primary delivery contact for clients, building trusted relationships through transparency, consistency, and clear communication while identifying opportunities to expand value within the engagement

* Lead stakeholder working sessions, roadmap alignment discussions, and delivery forums with confidence

* Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to executive and non-technical audiences

* Partner with Client Partners to spot expansion opportunities inside the engagement (scope, follow-on work, new use cases) and help shape the case for what's next

* Translate delivery progress into business impact for client stakeholders (ROI, milestones, decisions) so executives see ongoing value, not just status

**Leadership & Influence**

* Lead distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations, fostering accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence

* Coach junior delivery managers with concrete feedback and stretch opportunities, contributing to their development plans

* Foster a culture of transparency, continuous improvement, and high performance across the engagement

* Contribute to improving delivery practices, tools, and frameworks across engagements

* Assess team strengths and gaps on your engagements, and partner with Client Partners to flag staffing needs and high-potential talent for the firm

* Conduct executive interviews for engineers, designers, and other roles joining your engagements, and serve as an essential voice in go/no-go hiring decisions across the firm

  

**What** **You'll** **Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in software delivery, technical project management, or engineering leadership

* Strong understanding of agile delivery practices across complex, multi-team engagements (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, Kanban)

* Experience managing distributed teams across onshore and offshore locations

* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-platform digital systems in agile environments

* Strong client-facing communication and relationship management skills

* Experience with delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines)

* Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and AI-enabled platforms

* Demonstrable usage of AI tools to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and documentation (e.g., Claude)

* PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, or equivalent certification preferred

* Experience in regulated environments (e.g., utilities, government, finance) is a plus

* Instinct for spotting where an engagement can grow, and the credibility with clients to bring those conversations forward with Client Partners

  

**Helpful Extras and Unique Skills**

* Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing

* Experience delivering agentic, AI co-worker, or applied-AI initiatives in enterprise

* Prior career experience in client-facing roles (engagement management, consulting, account leadership) that informs growth conversations

**You'll** **Do Well Here if You Are**

* **A doer.** You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.

* **A fast learner who knows you don't know everything.** The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.

* **Direct in a way that makes the work better.** You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.

* **Obsessed with craft.** You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.

* **Built for ownership.** You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.

* **All in.** You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.

* **Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight.** Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.

* **Calm when it gets hot.** When scope, timeline, and stakeholders pull in three directions, you slow the room down enough to make the right call. You'd rather raise the hard trade-off in week two than absorb it in week eight.

* **Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do.** Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

Title: Head of Operations Canada
Description:
At elockers, we are on a mission to make live events smarter, easier and more enjoyable.

From world-class festivals and stadiums to iconic concert venues, we provide innovative self-service locker solutions that give visitors the freedom to enjoy unforgettable experiences without worrying about their belongings.

We work with some of the biggest names in live entertainment, including Live Nation, AEG, The Bowery Presents, Goldenvoice and Knockdown Center.

Founded in the Netherlands, elockers is rapidly expanding across Europe and North America. We are an ambitious, entrepreneurial company with big plans, strong partnerships and a passion for the live entertainment industry.

***Lock in. Own the operation.***

**Your mission**

You take ownership of our operations and key client relationships across Canada. Based in Toronto, you keep our existing venues and festivals running smoothly while building the operational structure for what comes next. This is a hands-on leadership role. You make decisions independently, represent elockers in the Canadian market and are just as comfortable on a festival site at 6 a.m. as in a meeting with a venue operator.

**What you'll build**

* **Operations that run.**
  You own the planning, preparation, execution and evaluation of our venue and festival operations across Canada, managing multiple projects from A to Z.
* **Boots on the ground.**
  Logistics, installations, maintenance, event support and breakdowns. When needed, you're onsite helping with installations and troubleshooting.
* **Strong client relationships.**
  You are the key contact for our venues, festivals and partners. You manage expectations, solve issues and keep satisfaction high.
* **Growth with existing partners.**
  You spot opportunities to expand partnerships and work closely with our commercial team on renewals and new projects.
* **A reliable local network.**
  You build and manage a flexible pool of part-time staff, freelancers, transport companies, warehouses and technical service providers.
* **A lean structure that scales.**
  You recruit, train and coordinate local teams, and set up operations that grow efficiently without an unnecessarily large permanent team.
* **Grip on performance.**
  You own operational planning, budgets, quality and reporting, and improve processes as the business grows.
* **One international team.**
  You work closely with our European team on logistics, technology, operations and commercial opportunities.

**What you bring**

* Several years of operations experience in live events, festivals, venues or a comparable fast-paced environment.
* Experience leading teams and managing external partners, freelancers and suppliers.
* You've built something from the ground up before and enjoy doing it again.
* You take ownership, act independently and solve problems before they become problems.
* Strong client skills. You're comfortable with major venue operators and festival organizers.
* Based in or around Toronto, with the flexibility to travel to venues and events across Canada.

**What you get**

* Ownership of the Canadian operation in an international scale-up.
* Real impact on how we grow in North America.
* A competitive package that reflects your level.

**Let's talk**

Sounds like your next step? Send your CV and a few lines on why this role appeals to you. Questions first? Contact Brendan Kriek at brendan@elockers.com or 0615348554.

Title: Manager Technology, Application Support
Description:
**It’s not a package. It’s a promise®.**
As Canada’s leading integrated freight, package, and logistics provider, we’ve been helping promises get where they need to be for more than 60 years. How does the magic happen?

**Description**
Purolator relies on a broad portfolio of production applications to support employees, customers, terminals, transportation, and business operations. We are seeking a technology manager to lead the team accountable for application support, reliability, lifecycle management, and enhancements across these services.
  
  
This role will strengthen the operating model for production support by ensuring that projects, support queues, knowledge, monitoring, incidents, vulnerabilities, maintenance, and improvement work are managed with discipline. The successful candidate will combine strong leadership with technical judgement to deliver on new functionality and projects, improve service health, reduce repeat issues, and make support work visible and sustainable.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop application support employees, contractors, and vendor resources across onshore and offshore locations.
* Own service health and support outcomes for assigned production applications, including availability, performance, security, supportability, and lifecycle risk.
* Establish clear queue ownership, triage standards, priorities, service targets, escalation paths, and workload reporting across incidents, requests, problems, defects, and enhancements.
* Ensure knowledge base articles, runbooks, support procedures, dependency maps, recovery steps, and escalation contacts are accurate, current, usable, and reviewed on a defined cadence.
* Drive strong incident and problem management practices, including major incident leadership, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, trend analysis, and prevention of repeat failures.
* Embed SRE practices such as service-level indicators and objectives, actionable monitoring, alert quality, capacity planning, error budgets, automation, resilience testing, and toil reduction.
* Partner with development teams to improve production readiness, operational acceptance, handoffs, release quality, deployment safety, and early-life support.
* Plan and deliver small enhancements, defect corrections, automation, maintenance, and technical-debt work without compromising operational support.
* Own application security hygiene, including vulnerability intake, CVE assessment, remediation planning, patch coordination, exception tracking, and executive reporting.
* Maintain lifecycle and technical-risk registers covering unsupported components, aging platforms, expiring certificates, capacity concerns, critical dependencies, and recovery gaps.
* Use ServiceNow, Jira, dashboards, and other systems of record to provide accurate visibility into work, aging, service performance, backlog health, and risk.
* Partner with Service Desk, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Cloud, Architecture, Product, Development, and business teams to resolve issues and improve end-to-end service ownership.
* Manage vendor service levels, statements of work, deliverables, escalations, invoices, budgets, contracts, and resource plans.
* Monitor and report AWS consumption, forecasts, optimization opportunities, and financial risks for supported applications.
* Set team goals, complete performance reviews, provide regular feedback, and support career development and succession planning.
* Provide concise reporting to the Director on service health, incidents, backlog, reliability, vulnerabilities, financials, people, risks, and decisions required.

**Additional Responsibilities**
Leadership expectations
  
  
You will create clarity, set measurable expectations, coach with candour, and build an inclusive team culture. You will balance delivery speed with security, reliability, cost, and long-term maintainability, while providing the Director with timely visibility into outcomes, risks, dependencies, capacity, vendor performance, and financials.
  
  
Operating model focus
  
  

* Clear ownership from intake through resolution, prevention, and knowledge capture
* Reliable queues, service targets, escalation paths, and stakeholder communications
* Measurable service health using logs, metrics, traces, synthetic checks, dashboards, and business signals
* Disciplined vulnerability, patch, certificate, dependency, and application lifecycle management
* A balanced backlog across incidents, defects, small enhancements, automation, reliability, security, and technical debt

**Education**

* Post-secondary diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* SRE, ITIL, DevOps, cloud, cybersecurity, architecture, or agile delivery certification are assets.

**Experience**

* Progressive experience in application support, production operations, software engineering, SRE, DevOps, or service management, including several years leading technical teams.
* Strong technical understanding of enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, databases, cloud services, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and common failure modes.
* Demonstrated success improving incident, problem, change, knowledge, monitoring, and vulnerability-management practices.
* Experience managing operational queues, support metrics, service targets, backlogs, small enhancements, and technical-debt priorities.
* Ability to use data to identify service trends, explain risk, prioritize investments, and hold teams and vendors accountable.
* Experience managing mixed employee, contractor, and vendor teams across locations and time zones.
* Strong financial, vendor, stakeholder, and executive-reporting skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a calm and structured approach during incidents and escalations.
* Experience supporting logistics, transportation, mobile, customer-facing, or 24x7 operational applications.
* Hands-on exposure to AWS, observability platforms, ServiceNow, Jira, GitHub, CI/CD tooling, and automated testing.
* Experience transitioning services from project delivery into stable production ownership.

Title: Head of IT Security
Description:
Job Description:

* Overall security posture of the Group's technology estate, measured against an agreed target maturity (e.g. NIST CSF / ISO 27001 controls)
* Detection and response: 24/7 monitoring coverage, mean time to detect and respond, and effective containment of security incidents
* Vulnerability and patch management: timely remediation of critical and high vulnerabilities across infrastructure and applications
* Identity and access security: privileged access management, MFA coverage and periodic access reviews
* Security by design: security requirements, architecture reviews and testing embedded in digital, cloud and AI projects before go-live
* Regulatory and certification compliance: clean audit outcomes against QCB, NCSA and ISO 27001 / PCI DSS requirements, and timely closure of findings
* Data protection controls (DLP, encryption, email and web security) protecting customer and corporate data
* Security awareness, phishing resilience and a well-structured, capable IT Security team
* Lead the IT Security function under the Group Chief Digital & AI Officer, alongside Head of Group IT and Head of Data & AI
* Owns first-line security controls and operations; works with the Cyber Security & Data Protection Officer (Group Risk) who owns security policy, risk appetite and second-line oversight
* Engages directly with Group IT, Data & AI, digital product teams, business units, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Legal and external vendors
* Operates information security policies, risk and compliance frameworks, and the requirements of QCB, NCSA (National Information Assurance standard), Qatar's personal data protection law and other applicable regulators
* Functions in a fast-changing environment of cloud adoption, digital ecosystem launches and AI deployment, with a 24/7 threat landscape
* Significant autonomy over security architecture, tooling and operations; escalates major incidents, material risks and risk acceptances to the Group Chief Digital & AI Officer and Group Risk
* Prioritizes security investments and remediation across a broad estate with finite budget, people and change windows
* Leads the response to live security incidents under time pressure — containment, forensics, recovery and lessons learned
* Balances strong controls with business agility, enabling digital and AI initiatives without creating unmanaged risk
* Assesses the security of new technologies (cloud services, APIs, third-party platforms, generative AI) and designs proportionate controls
* Interprets regulatory and audit requirements across multiple jurisdictions and translates them into practical technical controls
* Manages third-party and supply-chain security risk across technology vendors and outsourced services
* Translates technical threat and vulnerability data into clear, risk-based messages for executives and committee
* Defines IT security architecture, technical standards and baseline configurations for the Group's technology estate
* Selects security tools and managed-security providers and manages the security budget within delegated authority
* Approves or blocks go-live of systems and changes based on security review outcomes, within the agreed governance framework
* Directs incident response, including containment actions such as isolating systems or disabling compromised accounts
* Sets remediation priorities and deadlines for vulnerabilities and audit findings with Group IT and application owners
* Hires, develops and manages the performance of the IT Security team, in line with HR policies

Educational Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field
* Master's degree in Information Security or a related field is preferred
* Professional security certification (CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP or equivalent) strongly preferred; vendor certifications (e.g. Fortinet, Microsoft, cloud security) are an advantage

Experience:

* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT, with at least 5 years in information / cyber security
* Minimum 3 years leading an IT security or cybersecurity team, including SOC or security operations
* Proven track record in financial services (insurance, banking, payments or fintech) or another regulated industry
* Hands-on experience with enterprise security technologies: firewalls / NGFW, SIEM, EDR, WAF, DLP,IAM / PAM
* Experience leading ISO 27001 and / or PCI DSS compliance and regulatory or external audits
* Experience managing managed-security providers and international technology vendors • GCC / Qatar regulatory exposure (QCB, NCSA) is a strong plus; insurance industry experience is an advantage

Title: Senior Manager - IT/OT Network Security - AA9

* Experience working with OLAs, escalation matrices and governance in multi-party environments

Astera Labs’ Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe®, and UALink™ semiconductor-based technologies with the company’s COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems that deliver end-to-end scale-up, and scale-out connectivity. The company’s custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at www.asteralabs.com.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a
**Sr. Principal Program Manager, ASIC Design**
at Astera Labs, you will own the cross-functional execution framework for advanced ASIC programs from early planning through tapeout. You will drive milestones, dependencies, execution reviews, decision-making forums, risk management, and tapeout readiness across multiple engineering teams.
  
  
You will partner closely with architecture, RTL design, functional verification, emulation, DFT, synthesis, physical design, CAD, IP, product management, engineering leadership, and external partners.
  
  
This is a high-impact role for a technical program leader who can operate in a fast-moving environment, manage ambiguity, drive accountability, and establish scalable execution practices across complex silicon development programs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
  

* Program Execution & Planning

+ Lead pre-silicon execution of complex ASIC and subsystem programs from concept through tapeout.
+ Own program plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risk registers, dashboards, and executive-level status reporting.
+ Drive pre-silicon and NPD phase-gate execution from kickoff through final GDS handoff, ensuring cross-functional readiness across architecture, RTL, verification, DFT, physical design, signoff, and tapeout.

* Cross-Functional Alignment & Coordination

+ Drive cross-functional alignment across architecture, RTL design, verification, emulation, DFT, synthesis, physical design, CAD, IP integration, product management, and external partners.
+ Track IP delivery, PDK updates, CAD/EDA flow readiness, tool dependencies, and foundry requirements.
+ Partner with Post-Silicon PM and Validation teams to absorb feedback from post silicon bring up, including bug reports and Si issues.

* Risk Management & Decision-Making

+ Identify execution risks, lead risk mitigation plans, and drive trade-off decisions across scope, schedule, resources, and quality.
+ Communicate program health, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to engineering teams, senior leaders, executives, and external partners.

* Process & Operational Excellence

+ Establish scalable program management practices, operating rhythms, decision forums, documentation standards, and communication mechanisms, lead constant improvement.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in ASIC/SoC development or silicon program execution, including 3+ years in technical program management, engineering program management, or technical leadership.
* Experience managing pre-silicon ASIC development flows, including architecture planning, RTL design, functional verification, synthesis, DFT, physical design, timing closure, signoff, and tapeout.
* Experience with advanced process nodes and high-performance ASIC/SoC development.
* Strong understanding of ASIC development milestones from product requirements through final GDS handoff.
* Familiarity with EDA flows, CAD infrastructure, IP integration, PDK readiness, foundry requirements, and vendor dependency management.
* Experience with pre-silicon validation platforms such as simulation, emulation, FPGA prototyping, or hardware/software co-validation.
* Experience driving complex cross-functional programs with multiple engineering teams, technical dependencies, external vendors, and aggressive schedules.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong technical judgment with the ability to manage trade-offs across performance, power, area, cost, schedule, quality, and risk.
* Excellent communication, organizational, leadership, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to influence without authority across global, cross-functional, and cross-cultural teams.
* Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environment.
* Experience with high-speed connectivity, SerDes, PHY, PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, networking, switching, or AI infrastructure silicon.

Salary range is CAD 195,000 to CAD 240,000 depending on experience, level, and business need. This role may be eligible for discretionary bonus, incentives and benefits.

Title: Manager, AI Platform Observability & Monitoring
Description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.
  
  
Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve.
