Title: Engineering Manager
Description:
**Job Purpose:**

Lead team of software engineers within the Engineering & E-commerce function. Own the delivery, quality and production reliability of the systems within the assigned domain, such as ordering, menu serving, payments, loyalty, aggregator integration, in-store technology or customer platforms. Turn approved priorities into working, reliable software, delivered on time and at a controlled cost. This enables the company to serve customers and locations across markets and grow digital sales.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the assigned domain end to end - Own the architecture, roadmap execution, quality and production reliability of the domain’s systems and APIs. The scope of the domain will be assigned in writing by the line manager.
* Deliver the approved roadmap predictably - Define scope, estimate, sequence, manage risks and dependencies, and report status and trade-offs early, in line with the department’s software development lifecycle, so that commitments to the business are met.
* Own the system design and architecture of the domain - Propose designs and architecture changes and make technical trade-offs related to performance, resilience, data consistency, security, cost and time to market. Decisions must remain within the architecture principles and engineering standards established by the Director of Engineering & E-commerce and the engineering leadership.
* Own the reliability of the domain systems - Define and meet service-level objectives. Run on-call support, incident response and root-cause analysis. Monitor systems using the reliability tools provided by Platform Engineering and keep systems fast and efficient under peak loads.
* Use AI by default and advocate its use - Use AI for software development and the automation of other tasks, in line with the department’s AI usage standards. Maintain engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, secure coding and controlled releases, including feature flags, progressive rollouts and rollback plans.
* Act as custodian of the domain’s spend - Track cloud consumption, licences and contractor time. Identify and remove waste and raise cost risks early with the line manager. Commercial and budget decisions remain with the line manager and must follow company processes.
* Build, lead and grow a team of software engineers - Coach team members, provide regular feedback, manage performance and support career development. Contribute to hiring through the company’s recruitment process. Direct the day-to-day work of external developers, contractors or vendors when assigned to the domain.
* Align with peers and stakeholders before acting - Agree on interfaces, dependencies and priorities with other Engineering Managers, Product, Operations and business teams. Escalate disagreements to the line manager with clear options. Do not make unilateral decisions that change another team’s work, cost or risk.

**Leadership Requirements:**

* Ownership: Takes full accountability for the domain, its production systems and its people.
* Hands-on credibility: Designs systems and understands the code sufficiently to make sound technical decisions and coach engineers.
* AI-first mindset: Uses AI by default and leads the team to do the same.
* Delivery discipline: Plans realistically, commits carefully and keeps commitments.
* Calm under pressure: Leads clearly during incidents and peak periods.
* Decides through alignment: Works across team boundaries through agreement rather than authority.
* Financial responsibility: Treats company money responsibly in every technical decision.
* People development: Develops software engineers and builds a culture of engineering excellence.

**Major Challenges**

* Deliver new features while maintaining production stability.
* Manage dependencies on other teams and vendors that the role does not directly control.
* Reduce technical debt and modernize legacy systems while keeping the systems operational.
* Maintain delivery quality across a team comprising employees and external developers working in different locations.
* Migrate existing systems to the department’s standard programming language, Golang, while continuing ongoing delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field
* Cloud or architecture certification is an advantage

**Experience:**

* Five or more years of software engineering experience, including at least two years managing engineering teams
* Proven experience designing and delivering production-grade, high-availability systems
* Experience with consumer digital platforms within quick-service restaurants, retail, e-commerce, marketplaces or logistics is preferred
* Experience working with external developers, contractor teams or vendor teams is an advantage

**Job-Specific Skills:**

* System design and architecture: Service architecture, API design, data modelling, distributed systems, modern system design and cloud principles
* Programming: Golang is preferred. Java, C#, Node.js or PHP are accepted. Willingness to learn Golang and migrate systems to Golang is required
* Databases and caches: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis or Aerospike
* Messaging and streaming: Kafka and RabbitMQ
* Monitoring and reliability: Logs, metrics, traces, service-level objectives, alerting and incident response
* Performance: Profiling, load testing, latency optimisation and cost optimisation
* AI for engineering: Daily use of AI tools for development and the automation of other tasks
* Engineering quality: Automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, and secure coding.

**Generic Skills:**

* Clear communication and the ability to translate engineering details into business impact
* Stakeholder management
* Project management, including planning, estimation, risk management and dependency management
* Coaching and performance management

**Competencies:**

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ownership and accountability
* Delivery focus
* Collaboration and influence
* Developing people
* Customer focus
* Integrity

**Technical Competencies**

* System Design and Architecture: Advanced
* Backend Engineering: Advanced
* Reliability, Monitoring and Performance: Advanced
* AI-Assisted Engineering: Advanced
* Data Stores and Messaging: Advanced
* Cloud Principles: Intermediate
* Security and Data Privacy: Intermediate

Title: Technical Account Manager - Openshift (Remote, Doha with French)
Description:
Red Hat's Technical Services team is looking for an experienced, enterprise-level engineer to join us as a OpenShift Technical Account Manager (TAM).

In this role, you'll work with a small set of key customers to provide hands-on technical and architectural guidance for the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.

At Red Hat, customer support includes far more than just “break-fix” solutions. Customers get industry-leading resources that enable their technical environments to run efficiently, so they can focus on growing their businesses.

Technical account management is a premium support offering that builds, maintains, and grows long-lasting customer loyalty between Red Hat and our customers.

You will forge relationships with your customers, develop a deep technical understanding of their Red Hat implementation, share technical best practices and act as point of contact for any major incidents, managing the customer’s expectations and communications through resolution of such incidents.

You will tailor support for each customer's environment, facilitate collaboration with their other vendors and advocate on their behalf. At the same time, you'll work closely with our Engineering, Research and Development, Product Management, and Global Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues.

The ideal TAM is a team player, enjoys working hard, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, building relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, is able to learn new technologies quickly and uses their time efficiently.

**What you will do:**

  

* Develop relationships with key business and IT stakeholders and become an expert on a customer’s implementation by understanding their top business goals and priorities.
* Perform technical reviews and share knowledge to proactively identify and prevent issues
* Forewarn customers of technology changes or potential disruptions to their service and advice on mitigation strategies.
* Provide advice and guidance to customers about their current and future Red Hat products;
* Troubleshoot technical issues and drive issue escalation with Red Hat and customer teams
* Complete analysis and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customer leadership
* Manage customer use cases and maintain clear and concise case documentation
* Create customer engagement plans and keep the documentation on the customer's environment updated
* Manage and grow customer relationships by delivering attentive, relationship-based support
* Build a sense of trust with customers and serve as their advocate within Red Hat
* Contribute internally to the Red Hat team, share knowledge and best practices with team members, contribute to internal projects and initiatives, and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and mentor for specific technical or process areas
* Partner closely with Red Hat Engineering, Product Management, and Technical Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues
* Travel, as necessary, to visit customers and attend events within the region
* Learn new technologies quickly, including topics like container orchestration, container registries, container build strategies, and microservices on container platforms
* Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat cloud technologies strategy
* Engage with Red Hat’s product engineering teams to help develop solution patterns, based on customer engagements, as well as personal experience, that drive platform adoption
* Engage with Red Hat’s field teams, customers, and partners to ensure a positive cloud technology experience and a successful outcome resulting in long-term enterprise success
* Communicate how specific Red Hat cloud solutions and our cloud roadmap align to customer use cases

**What you will bring:**

* **5 years experience in a support, development, engineering, or quality assurance** organisation
* Expertise with enterprise cloud solutions like **Platform-as-a-Service** **(OpenShift by Red Hat), containers, Kubernetes**, **cloud management**, and **IT automation** (Ansible Automation Platform by Red Hat)
* Ability to manage and grow existing enterprise customer relationships by delivering proactive, relationship-based support
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers clearly and concisely
* Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
* Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with an eye for detail
* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors
* Good verbal and written communication skills in French

**The following are considered a plus:**

* Experience in system management, cloud or server virtualization
* Bachelor's degree in a technology-related discipline, preferably computer science or engineering
* **Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)**
* Prior experience in a technical leadership or mentorship role
* Experience with training and presentation delivery

**About Red Hat**

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

**Inclusion at Red Hat**  
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

**Join Us**

At Serco, we believe there is a place here for everyone. A place where you can bring your authentic self to work every day. Our workplace culture is one that embraces diversity and fosters equity, respect, and belonging for every individual. We are committed to equal employment opportunities and creating an inclusive environment that proudly celebrates the perspectives and backgrounds that each of our employees bring to work every day.

Join Serco and be part of a values-driven organization that invests in the development and well-being of its employees and offers a rewarding and fulfilling career.

Serco is committed to Equal Employment Opportunities and is committed to ensuring the safety of all of its employees through its Zero Harm initiative. Please visit **careers.serco.com** for more information.

Title: Director of Business Technology
Description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Title: Gestionnaire, plateformes technologiques d’ingénierie
Description:
**Job Description**
**Et si vous pouviez redéfinir ce qui est possible? Avec nous, vous le pouvez.**

Nous sommes le foyer de personnes ambitieuses, passionnées et innovantes qui façonnent le monde de demain.
  
  
Grâce à une expertise inégalée en ingénierie, en services-conseils et en sciences, nos équipes à travers le monde unissent leurs forces pour créer des solutions adaptées aux réalités locales.
  
  
Nous ouvrons la voie et générons un impact.
  
  
Nous sommes des visionnaires.
  
  
Nous sommes WSP.
  
  
**L’opportunité**
Prenez les commandes de la stratégie, de la livraison, de la gouvernance et de l’excellence opérationnelle des plateformes technologiques qui soutiennent les applications d’ingénierie de WSP à l’échelle mondiale. Dans ce rôle de leadership, vous contribuerez à créer des environnements sécuritaires, évolutifs, résilients et rentables couvrant notamment l’hébergement d’applications, les plateformes infonuagiques et hébergées par des fournisseurs, l’infrastructure de bureau virtuel (VDI), la gouvernance des données, l’automatisation et les technologies d’ingénierie de nouvelle génération.
  
  
En collaborant avec les équipes Client Delivery Solutions (CDS), Infrastructure, Sécurité, Architecture, Données et IA ainsi qu’avec les équipes d’ingénierie, vous contribuerez à créer les conditions permettant à nos équipes de projets et à nos professionnels de l’ingénierie de donner le meilleur d’eux-mêmes, tout en préparant WSP aux technologies et aux méthodes de travail de demain.
  
  
**Votre impact**

* Façonner la stratégie et les opérations des plateformes d’ingénierie : Définir et gouverner la stratégie technologique des plateformes soutenant les applications d’ingénierie mondiales. Assurer la préparation opérationnelle, la disponibilité, la performance, la résilience et l’évolutivité des environnements technologiques d’ingénierie. Établir les normes de plateforme, les cadres de gouvernance technique et les procédures d’exploitation des services, tout en dirigeant la planification du cycle de vie et les initiatives de modernisation.
* Faire évoluer l’infrastructure de bureau virtuel et les environnements informatiques d’ingénierie : Définir la stratégie et la feuille de route relatives aux environnements VDI et aux solutions informatiques à distance pour l’ingénierie. Collaborer avec les équipes Infrastructure afin d’optimiser la performance, l’expérience utilisateur, l’accélération graphique et les charges de travail d’ingénierie. Définir les normes relatives aux postes de travail d’ingénierie, aux postes infonuagiques et aux modèles de prestation hybrides, tout en évaluant les technologies et les nouvelles approches de déploiement.
* Gouverner la demande, la livraison et les ressources : Superviser l’admission, la priorisation et la réalisation des initiatives technologiques d’ingénierie. Gérer l’affectation des ressources, la planification de la capacité des équipes et les priorités de livraison. Collaborer avec le CDS Front Door, le PMO, l’Architecture et les parties prenantes d’affaires afin d’assurer la bonne exécution des initiatives de plateforme, tout en surveillant la performance de livraison, les risques, les dépendances et la réalisation de la valeur.
* Renforcer la gouvernance des données et la gestion du cycle de vie de l’information : Définir les pratiques de gouvernance et de gestion du cycle de vie des données provenant des applications d’ingénierie. Élaborer des stratégies de conservation, d’archivage, de récupération, de conformité et d’accessibilité à long terme. Gouverner les environnements applicatifs hébergés par des fournisseurs ainsi que ceux hébergés dans l’environnement infonuagique de WSP. Collaborer avec les équipes Gouvernance des données, Sécurité, Juridique et Conformité afin de respecter les normes de l’entreprise et soutenir les stratégies favorisant l’analytique, l’IA et la livraison numérique.
* Accélérer l’innovation et l’adoption de technologies d’avenir : Évaluer les technologies émergentes, les services infonuagiques, les plateformes d’ingénierie alimentées par l’IA et les possibilités d’automatisation. Élaborer des feuilles de route technologiques adaptées à l’évolution des modèles de prestation en ingénierie. Cerner les possibilités d’amélioration de la productivité, de l’évolutivité, de la durabilité et de l’expérience utilisateur, et diriger des preuves de concept, projets pilotes d’innovation et programmes de modernisation technologique.
* Diriger la gouvernance des plateformes et la collaboration interfonctionnelle : Collaborer avec les équipes Infrastructure, Cybersécurité, Architecture d’entreprise et Opérations afin d’assurer l’alignement des plateformes. Définir les normes techniques, les pratiques de gestion du changement et les processus de gouvernance opérationnelle. Veiller à ce que les changements apportés aux plateformes d’ingénierie soient testés, documentés et soutenus sur le plan opérationnel, tout en assurant un leadership lors d’escalades techniques complexes et d’initiatives de plateforme à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
* Assurer la gestion financière et le leadership auprès de la haute direction : Gérer les budgets des plateformes, les prévisions, la planification des investissements et les initiatives d’optimisation. Élaborer des analyses de rentabilité et des recommandations d’investissement technologique. Favoriser l’optimisation des coûts liés à l’infonuagique, à l’infrastructure, à l’hébergement et aux services opérationnels, et produire des rapports destinés à la direction, des tableaux de bord, des présentations et des mises à jour de gouvernance.
* Développer l’équipe mondiale et le modèle opérationnel : Diriger et développer une équipe mondiale de spécialistes des plateformes et des technologies d’ingénierie. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des modèles évolutifs de prestation et de soutien. Diriger la planification de la main-d’œuvre, le développement des capacités, le perfectionnement des compétences et la planification de la relève. Établir des structures de gouvernance et des modèles d’engagement pour les parties prenantes d’affaires et les équipes TI interfonctionnelles, tout en favorisant une culture de responsabilisation, d’innovation, de collaboration et d’amélioration continue.

**Les compétences qui vous distinguent**

* Formation et leadership des plateformes d’entreprise : Baccalauréat en technologies de l’information, informatique, ingénierie ou dans une discipline connexe, ainsi qu’une expérience significative dans la gestion de plateformes d’entreprise, de services d’infrastructure, de technologies infonuagiques ou d’environnements d’applications d’ingénierie.
* Expertise des environnements informatiques d’ingénierie : Expérience des environnements VDI, de l’informatique d’ingénierie, des plateformes d’hébergement infonuagique et de la prestation d’applications à l’échelle de l’entreprise. Une expérience des écosystèmes d’applications liés à l’ingénierie, au BIM, aux SIG/GIS, à la livraison numérique, à la simulation ou à la conception constitue un atout.
* Expertise en gouvernance des données : Solide compréhension des pratiques de gouvernance, de conservation, d’archivage et de gestion du cycle de vie des données, combinée à une connaissance des cadres d’architecture d’entreprise, de cybersécurité et de gouvernance des données.
* Leadership dans la réalisation d’initiatives complexes : Expérience de la gestion de portefeuilles de livraison technique et d’initiatives interfonctionnelles complexes. Expérience avec ITIL, Agile, SAFe ou des méthodologies de livraison comparables.
* Leadership mondial et modèles opérationnels : Expérience de la direction d’équipes techniques mondiales et de la transformation de modèles opérationnels.
* Gestion financière et investissements technologiques : Solide expérience de la gestion financière et des investissements technologiques, notamment en matière de budgets, de prévisions, de dossiers d’affaires, d’investissements et d’optimisation des coûts.
* Transformation infonuagique et modernisation : Expérience avec Microsoft Azure, les architectures cloud natives, les plateformes DaaS/VDI ainsi que les initiatives de modernisation de l’infrastructure. Expérience dans la direction de transformations infonuagiques et d’initiatives de modernisation des plateformes.
* Influence auprès des parties prenantes et de la haute direction : Excellentes aptitudes en gestion des parties prenantes, en communication avec la haute direction et en présentation. Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Description:
Job Description:

Referral Level: Level 1

Location: Toronto/Winnipeg

**Mackenzie Investments**

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Mackenzie Investments, founded in 1967, is a key part of IGM's business model, serving as a comprehensive asset-management partner for Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

**At Mackenzie Investments, we believe being invested starts with our people.** We are proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers for the fourth consecutive year and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers. Our vision and strategy aim to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

**Role Overview**  
The Manager, IT Audit reports to the Director, IT Audit and is responsible for planning and executing risk-based technology audit and advisory engagements. This role focuses on assessing risks and controls across cloud environments, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, and enterprise technology platforms. The successful candidate will work closely with technology and business stakeholders to provide practical, risk-based recommendations that strengthen governance, risk management, and control processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage AI and analytics tools to improve audit efficiency, risk assessment, testing methodologies, and reporting processes.
* Assess governance and controls over AI and machine learning solutions, including model development, validation, monitoring, explainability, accountability, bias management, and data governance.
* Develop and execute data-enabled audit approaches using analytics, visualization, automation, and continuous auditing techniques.
* Assess risks associated with generative AI technologies, large language models, agentic systems, and third-party AI services.
* Lead and execute technology audit engagements from planning through reporting.
* Perform audits of cloud environments, including governance, security, identity and access management, resilience, and third-party risk controls.
* Assess DevSecOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, secure software development practices, and deployment controls.
* Evaluate governance, risk management, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations associated with AI solutions and emerging technologies.
* Assess IT general controls, automated controls, application controls, and cybersecurity controls.
* Participate in audits of major technology transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, and digital programs.
* Support integrated audits by identifying technology risks that may impact business processes.
* Develop clear and concise audit findings and recommendations.
* Build effective relationships with technology, cybersecurity, risk management, and business stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging risks and industry trends related to cloud computing, AI, cyber security, and software engineering.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across audit methodologies, quality assurance processes, audit technology, and reporting practices.
* Act as a trusted advisor to technology leadership on risk, governance, and control matters.
* Provide guidance and coaching to junior auditors and co-op students where applicable.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of technology risk management and control frameworks including NIST, COBIT, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Hands-on experience auditing cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience reviewing DevSecOps environments, Agile delivery practices, CI/CD pipelines, and software development lifecycle controls.

* Experience using data analytics and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Diligent/ ACL, Python, SQL, Databricks, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding AI governance, AI model risks, data quality, privacy, explainability, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience with scripting, automation, or audit technology solutions to improve assurance effectiveness.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including identity and access management, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and incident response.

**Professional Experience**  

* 5-8 years of experience in IT audit, technology risk, cybersecurity, data analytics, or related assurance functions, with demonstrated experience leading complex audit engagements.
* Experience in financial services, asset management, wealth management, or other regulated industries is preferred.
* Experience working with cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and AI-related risks is required.

**Education and Certifications**

**Mandatory Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)

**Preferred / Optional Certifications**  

* CPA (Certified Professional Accountant) or CIA (Certified Internal Auditor)

* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) certification.
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager).  
  + CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional).
  + Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
  + ISACA Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) or equivalent AI audit certification.

**Leadership and Competencies**  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong stakeholder relationship management skills.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

**Additional Information**  

* Hybrid work model (3 days in office per week).
* Occasional travel may be required.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $86,000 - $123,000 which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

**Benefits*****:***

* **COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION & RECOGNITION:** competitive base salary, performance-weighted bonus, education/career support, option to join Employee Share Purchase Plan with employer matching component.
* **EMPLOYEE BENEFITS & INSURANCE:** competitive health and dental coverage, flexible plan for you and your family and short-term & long-term disability plans.
* **RETIREMENT SAVINGS PROGRAMS:** voluntary Group RRSP enrolment with employer matching component.
* **WORK LIFE BALANCE:** paid volunteer days, competitive time off including 10 wellness days off, WorkPerks discount program, hybrid & flex work arrangements.
* **INCLUSIVE CULTURE AND DIVERSITY:** living our core values: Be a Team, Be Accountable, Be Better, engaging with community through Business Resource Groups (BRG communities are volunteer employee-led groups formed around a common interest, identity, or background).

IGM is a diverse workplace committed to doing business inclusively - this starts with having a representative workforce! We encourage applications from all qualified candidates that represent the diversity present across Canada – including racialized persons, women, Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, 2SLGBTQIA+ community, gender diverse and neurodiverse individuals, as well as all who may contribute to the further diversification of ideas.

Mackenzie Investments is an accessible employer committed to providing barrier-free recruitment experience. If you require accommodation or this information in an alternate format at any stage of the recruitment process, please reach out to the Talent Acquisition team who will work with you to meet your needs.

**How to Apply:** Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience to **https://www.mackenzieinvestments.com/en/careers**.

**Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment:** As part of our Talent Acquisition process, we may use artificial intelligence and automated tools to support activities such as candidate sourcing, application review, and interview scheduling. These tools support the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by people.

We thank all applicants for their interest in Mackenzie Investments; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please apply by December 3 2026.

Working closely with technology teams, facilities, construction partners, specialist vendors and senior stakeholders stakeholders, you will ensure that technical workstreams are delivered in line with programme milestones, enterprise standards and regulatory requirements.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a complex, high-profile technology programme, ensuring a seamless transition to a modern, secure and fully operational workplace environment.

* **End-to-end technology delivery:** You will own the programme from planning and design through infrastructure deployment, testing, migration, go-live and operational handover, ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivery milestones.

* **Extensive technical programme delivery experience:** At least 7 years of experience managing complex technology programmes, ideally including modern corporate office fit-outs, smart building deployments, workplace transformations or greenfield technology implementations.
* **Smart Building, IoT & Emerging Digital Technologies:** Recent, demonstrable experience delivering and integrating smart building technologies, including Building Management Systems (BMS), intelligent control systems, IoT platforms and connected infrastructure, with exposure to emerging technologies such as Digital Twins, digital avatars and AI-enabled building solutions.
* **Enterprise IT infrastructure expertise:** Strong technical understanding of enterprise networking, telecommunications, structured cabling, IDF/MDF environments, data centre dependencies and infrastructure resilience, including integration with modern building systems.
* **Security and workplace technology understanding:** Experience coordinating physical security and cybersecurity requirements, ccess control, CCTV, end-user computing, meeting room technologies, collaboration platforms and associated operational support services.
* **Programme management and governance:** Demonstrated experience managing multiple technical workstreams, delivery partners, budgets, risks and dependencies, including coordinating technology delivery with construction and facilities teams, and overseeing business continuity and operational readiness.
* **Stakeholder engagement and communication:** Ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders, technical specialists, construction teams and external vendors.

**Bonus Points For**

* PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, ITIL or other recognised project and programme management certifications.
* Experience delivering technology programmes within Financial Services, Government or other highly regulated environments.
* Hands-on experience implementing Digital Twin platforms, digital avatars or AI-enabled building management and automation solutions.

* Deliver high-impact solutions for leading organisations.
* Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.
* Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.

* Help shape the future of business and technology transformation across the region.

Title: Panel Builder Program Leader META
Description:
Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
  
  
**About Eaton**
Eaton is a power management company where we provide energy-efficient solutions that help our customers effectively manage electrical, hydraulic and mechanical power more efficiently, safely and sustainably. Eaton is dedicated to improving the quality of life and the environment through the use of power management technology and services. Eaton has approximately 96,000 employees and sells products to customers in more than 175 countries.
  
  
The
**Panel Builder Program Manager, META**
is responsible for developing, governing and scaling Eaton’s panel builder partner program across the Middle East, Türkiye and Africa. The role creates a consistent regional framework that enables Eaton to recruit, engage, develop and grow panel builder partners while allowing effective adaptation to local market needs.
  
  
Reporting to Commercial Excellence & Marketing META, the role works through country sales, channel marketing, product and segment teams to strengthen partner capability, increase specification and preference for Eaton solutions, generate sustainable project pipeline and improve Eaton’s share of wallet. The role provides functional leadership to the regional panel builder community and serves as the central marketing and program contact for strategic panel builder partners.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the META panel builder program strategy, framework, value proposition, governance and annual operating plan, aligned with regional commercial priorities and Eaton’s brand standards.
* Define partner segmentation, qualification criteria and tiering based on capability, market potential, strategic fit, performance and commitment to Eaton.
* Design the end-to-end partner lifecycle covering recruitment, onboarding, certification, enablement, activation, development, retention and performance management.
* Build differentiated benefits and requirements for each program tier, including training, technical support, demand generation, digital tools, recognition and joint business planning.
* Lead functional alignment of country sales and marketing teams responsible for local program deployment; provide playbooks, tools, training and performance guidance.
* Develop joint business and marketing plans with priority panel builders, including agreed growth objectives, target segments, opportunity pipelines, campaigns and investment plans.
* Coordinate technical and commercial enablement with Product, Segment, Sales and Engineering teams, including solution training, design support, application guidance and new-product introductions.
* Create scalable to-partner and through-partner communications, localized content, co-branded campaigns and events that increase engagement and generate demand.
* Drive adoption of partner portals, product configurators, digital design tools, partner locators, customer relationship management and other relevant digital platforms.
* Establish clear program measures and dashboards covering partner recruitment, certification, engagement, pipeline, conversion, revenue, share of wallet, digital adoption and satisfaction.
* Govern program investments and marketing development funds, ensuring transparent allocation, compliant execution and measurable return on investment.
* Capture partner and customer feedback through structured voice-of-customer activities, advisory forums and satisfaction surveys; translate insights into program improvements.
* Coordinate relationships with strategic regional panel builders and relevant industry associations while supporting country teams in developing local partner communities.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, engineering or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in B2B channel, partner-program, commercial or marketing roles within the electrical industry. Demonstrated experience working across multiple META markets and influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority is required.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of panel building, low-voltage electrical distribution, partner-program design and channel business models.
* Proficiency in partner segmentation, joint business planning, demand generation, pipeline management, marketing investment governance, performance analytics and digital partner platforms.
* Working knowledge of applicable data-privacy, competition and compliance requirements.
* Advanced stakeholder management, communication, presentation, facilitation and influencing skills.
* Strong strategic and analytical thinking, customer focus, cultural awareness, project management, accountability and decision-making.
* Able to lead through influence, manage competing priorities and convert partner insight into scalable regional actions.

**Living and Working in Dubai**
Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
  
  
At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.

Title: Manager, Care Operations
Description:
**Overview**
Tonal Care runs seven days a week across an in-house Toronto team and an outsourced partner operation. The Manager, Care Operations owns how that operation performs day to day.
  
  
You will own daily delivery across all tiers, the operational relationship with our outsourced partner, and the staffing and capacity plans that keep service levels intact. You will lead a Team Lead and a team of Customer Experience Specialists, each of whom owns one or two lines of business, and you will work the queue yourself when coverage requires it.
  
  
This is a hands-on, player/coach, operating role. You set the standard, work within it, and hold the operation to it.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Daily Delivery
  
  

* Act as a player-coach during the initial phase, spending dedicated time working directly in the queue alongside specialists to model best practices, coach in real time, and establish baseline workflows
* Own daily delivery across all tiers, setting service levels, coverage models, and workflow standards that hold consistent delivery across phone, email, chat, and video.
* Own the daily, weekly, and monthly plans for SLA, CSAT, Average Handle Time, and First Contact Resolution, and be accountable for hitting them.
* Identify performance trends, operational risks, and root causes, and build the action plans that close the gap.
* Lead regular performance reviews and operational business reviews with internal stakeholders and partner leadership.
* Support incident and volume management during elevated contact periods, product issues, launches, and other business disruptions.
* Work the queue yourself when coverage requires it — absences, PTO, peak volume, or an uncovered line of business. You are the final backstop on coverage.
* Translate operational data into clear insights and recommendations for Care leadership.

Outsourced Partner Performance
  
  

* Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact for Tonal’s outsourced partner, managing performance through their team leads and supervisors.
* Hold partner leadership accountable to agreed KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, staffing commitments, and Tonal’s brand voice.
* Run weekly performance reviews with partner teams.
* Report weekly to our Logistics, Field Operations, and Care Leadership team across all Care Operations metrics.
* Partner with their leadership on performance improvement plans, staffing strategies, coaching opportunities, and operational readiness.
* Monitor partner staffing, attrition, attendance, and utilization to catch capacity risk before it reaches Members.
* Make sure partner teams are aligned to Tonal policies, workflows, and operating standards, and are prepared for new programs, product changes, and launches.
* Escalate to the Senior Manager, Care Operations when partner performance issues cannot be resolved at the working level. Contract terms, rates, and renewals sit with the Director of Care Operations.

Staffing and Capacity
  
  

* Own workforce planning with partner Workforce Management and Tonal analytics, setting capacity and staffing models against forecast demand and adjusting intraday to protect service levels.
* Plan coverage across the full seven-day operating window, including weekends, holidays, and peak periods.
* Own the volume, staffing, and partner utilization assumptions that feed Care’s operating budget.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and adjust staffing assumptions based on actual contact volume, productivity, shrinkage, and service-level performance.
* Ensure schedules keep the teams at a sustainable working load rather than at full utilization, so there is room to absorb spikes and absences.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and develop the team through the Team Lead and senior specialists, owning performance calibration, coaching, career development, and coverage planning.
* Make sure every line of business has a named owner, that the assignment is understood, and that owners are held to how their domain performs.
* Be accountable for the escalations programme. Specialists and the Team Lead resolve individual escalations; you own how the programme performs and where it needs to change.
* Sit in the health, safety, and legal escalation chain: Specialist → Team Lead → Manager, Care Operations → Senior Manager, Care Operations → Director, Care Operations.
* Ensure clear ownership and communication on sensitive, complex, or high-risk Member situations.
* Monitor escalation trends to surface recurring Member pain points, and work with the frontline to reduce avoidable escalations and lift first contact resolution.

Process and Partnership
  
  

* Translate the operating plan set with the Senior Manager, Care Operations into daily execution, and own that execution.
* Work with the Care Enablement team to identify knowledge gaps and roll out new troubleshooting SOPs, training, and tool updates to the front line.
* Coordinate with Logistics and Field Operations to deliver a seamless end-to-end experience for both specialists and Members.
* Simplify workflows to reduce Member effort, improve specialist efficiency, and remove unnecessary operational friction.
* Represent Care Operations in cross-functional initiatives and launches, and support the rollout and adoption of new tools, processes, and support programs.

Coverage and Schedule
  
  
Tonal Care operates seven days a week, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST. This is a hands-on leadership role and the coverage expectations come with it:
  
  

* You and your team may be required to work weekends, holidays, and after hours as coverage requires. You and your team’s schedule will shift with the needs of the operation.
* Your team will carry on-call responsibility for incidents, outages, product issues, and elevated volume periods.
* Priorities change during the day. Peak season, launches, and product escalations will change what a day looks like.

Who You Are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, or Contact Center Operations, including 2+ years leading teams, vendors, or outsourced operations.
* You are operationally minded and move comfortably between the operating plan and the queue. You set the standard, then hold the operation to it.
* You have managed operational KPIs and used data to find and fix performance problems. You don’t just report numbers — you understand the why behind them and change process, staffing, or enablement to move the trend.
* You are an empathetic coach who knows how to motivate a team and can turn complex data into feedback a specialist can act on.
* You have handled complex escalations and high-impact customer situations, and you are comfortable navigating gray areas and making quick, sound decisions when they arise.
* You have strong vendor and stakeholder management skills, and can influence partners who don’t report to you.
* You are technically savvy and proficient in CRM and support tooling, with an understanding of how backend systems shape the frontline experience.
* You prioritize influence over authority, earning the trust of your team and stakeholders to drive results through collaboration rather than mandate.
* You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities and evolving processes.

Why You Will Love Working at Tonal
  
  

* You will own the operating model for a Care organization that is scaling across channels and lines of business
* Competitive compensation package, benefits, and Tonal product perks
* Collaborative, mission-driven team with a passion for redefining strength training

At Tonal, we believe that the unique and varied lived experiences of our teammates contribute to our overall strength. We don’t just appreciate differences, we celebrate them, and we always seek people that represent a wide variety of backgrounds. We’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and designing employee experiences that contribute to your growth as much as you do to ours. If your experience aligns with what we’re looking for (even if you don’t check every single box), send us your application. We would love to hear from you!
  
  
Tonal is committed to meeting the diverse needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner that is consistent with the principles of independence, dignity, integration, and equality of opportunity. Should you have any accommodation requests, please reach out to us via our confidential email, accessibility@tonal.com. All requests will be addressed and responded to in accordance with Tonal’s Accessibility Policy and local legislation.

* Review time on site, labor hours, overtime, mileage, and expenses to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Provide accurate updates on staffing needs, workload, project progress, and operational risks.

#### **Safety and Accountability**

* Reinforce safe work practices, proper tool use, and customer site requirements.
* Address unsafe conditions and ensure incidents are reported promptly.
* Maintain accountability for company equipment, tools, inventory, and assigned assets.

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Experience in field services, technical operations, installation, maintenance, or a related industry.
* Previous experience supervising, leading, or coordinating technicians.

* Ability to interpret scopes of work, installation instructions, wiring diagrams, and site documentation.

Title: Office Manager
Description:
**Primary Impact**

Evolving Solutions is a leading technology solutions provider that helps clients modernize and automate their mission-critical applications and infrastructure to support business transformation. Our business is client-centric consulting and delivery of technical solutions to enable modern operations in a hybrid cloud world.

Our team is looking for an Office Manager to own the day-to-day operation of our corporate office and create a professional, organized, and welcoming experience for employees, clients, partners, vendors, and guests. This hands-on role keeps the workplace running smoothly by coordinating reception, meetings, office services, supplies, facilities, and shared spaces.

As the primary point of coordination for the office, this position manages visitor experiences, meeting logistics, food and beverage service, workplace communications, office inventory, vendors, and routine facility needs. The Office Manager notices what needs attention, follows through, and establishes practical processes that support a productive and engaging workplace.

Success in this role requires strong organization, hospitality, attention to detail, sound judgment, and a willingness to handle both planned responsibilities and immediate office needs. The Office Manager balances service to employees and guests with consistent ownership of the physical workplace and its daily routines.

**Evolving Solution Core Values**

* **Do the Right Thing:** Do what is right every day. Your personal integrity and the reputation of Evolving Solutions depends on this.
* **Be a Team Player:** Evolving Solutions is better when everyone is together. The ability to solve problems as a team for our clients and partners is Evolving Solutions’ strength and differentiation.
* **Be Humbly Confident:** Possess knowledge and experience to deliver at the highest level, while maintaining the willingness to learn more and the humility to recognize you will never know it all.

**Who You Are:**

* A relationship builder. You take pride in your emotional intelligence and strive to foster meaningful professional connections.
* You take pride in doing things right, maintain strong attention to detail, and are capable of managing many moving parts.
* You keep calm in the face of change, pressure, and short deadlines.
* You use excellent listening and communication skills to gather the information needed to execute your responsibilities effectively.
* You have a sense of urgency in supporting employees, clients, and vendor partners.
* You are self-driven, have a strong work ethic, and work well with minimal supervision.
* You are approachable and have a strong sense of integrity and discernment.
* You challenge the status quo and build practical processes that fit the organization’s current needs.
* You lead with empathy and inclusion, embodying our Core Value of being a team player.

**What You Will Do:**

The duties and responsibilities of this position consist of, but are not limited to, the following:

**Reception, Visitors & Office Communications**

* Answer incoming calls, route inquiries, and distribute messages promptly.
* Greet visitors at the front door, notify their host, offer beverages, and help create a professional arrival experience.
* Coordinate visitor communications with Sales, Marketing, partners, and internal hosts, including directing employees to the visitor request process and communicating informal visits when a request is not submitted.
* Maintain organized office records and file executed NDA, sales, and partner agreements in the appropriate permanent files.
* Coordinate routine office communications and digital signage, including employee birthday and anniversary slides and materials provided by leadership or Marketing.

**Administrative & Scheduling Support**

* Provide scheduling support for designated leaders, including coordinating meetings and maintaining recurring calendar reminders.
* Prepare PowerPoint slides and meeting materials as requested.
* Support registrations, accommodations, or other administrative logistics for company meetings and events when assigned.

**Office Management & Workplace Operations**

* Oversee daily office operations, including opening and closing routines such as office lighting and information monitors.
* Maintain conference rooms, reception areas, kitchens, and collaborative spaces so they are clean, stocked, organized, and ready for use.
* Manage recurring workplace routines, including stocking beverages and hospitality items, monitoring refrigerators and food storage, running or unloading the dishwasher, cleaning whiteboards, and addressing kitchen trash when needed.
* Order and maintain inventory of office, kitchen, paper, coffee, printer, and meeting supplies through approved vendors.
* Coordinate routine equipment and facility needs, including copier, printer, toner, furniture, maintenance, and service requests.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for building management and workplace vendors, including office beverage, plant care, and supply providers.
* Develop and maintain practical office procedures, checklists, and inventory practices that improve consistency and employee experience.
* Support office safety, security, and emergency preparedness activities.

**Workplace Experience & Employee Support**

* Create a positive employee and visitor experience through responsive, service-oriented support and a consistently welcoming office environment.
* Partner with HR and Marketing on office events, employee celebrations, digital signage, and culture initiatives.
* Assist with onboarding logistics, workspace setup, and welcome activities for new employees.
* Serve as the first resource for office-related questions, needs, or issues and coordinate timely resolution.

**Meeting & Event Coordination**

* Coordinate internal, customer, partner, leadership, and company-wide meetings and events held in the office.
* Manage meeting logistics, including room reservations, visitor coordination, catering, beverage service, technology readiness, attendee communications, and materials.
* Order and set up food for meetings, monitor hospitality needs during larger events, clean and reset rooms afterward, and store or dispose of leftovers appropriately.
* Coordinate service providers and track expenses associated with office meetings and events.
* Maintain recurring meeting and event checklists to support consistent setup, service, and follow-through.

**Vendor & Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain productive relationships with vendors, service providers, landlords, customers, and business partners.
* Manage contracts, renewals, and administrative vendor relationships as assigned.
* Evaluate office service providers and recommend improvements where appropriate.

**Office Processes & Administrative Operations**

* Lead or support office-related projects and workplace improvements.
* Coordinate office-related activities across departments and follow through on deadlines and commitments.
* Identify practical ways to improve office routines, service levels, and workplace efficiency.

**Confidentiality & Professionalism**

* Handle highly confidential business, financial, strategic, and personnel information with appropriate discretion.
* Exercise sound judgment when managing sensitive situations and communications.
* Represent the organization and leadership team in a professional and service-oriented manner.

**Qualifications:**

**Required**

* 5+ years of experience in office management, workplace operations, hospitality, facilities coordination, administrative support, or a similar role.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating office operations, visitors, meetings, vendors, supplies, and shared workplace spaces.

**Preferred:**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree.
* Experience providing hospitality-oriented support for employees, customers, partners, and guests.
* Experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organizational, planning, and project coordination skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy while handling multiple tasks.
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote.
* Strong customer service and relationship management skills, with the ability to interact professionally with employees, clients, executives, vendors, and business partners.
* Ability to work independently, anticipate needs, solve problems proactively, and exercise sound judgment.

**Work location**

* In-office position. Corporate office in Hamel, MN

**Reporting Relationship**

* Head of People and Culture

*Evolving Solutions* is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Title: Associate Director, Commercial Information Architecture
Description:
**Location** Wilmington, Delaware, United States **Job ID** R-264741 **Date posted** 24/11/2026

  

**WHY JOIN US?**At AstraZeneca, we are dedicated to being a Great Place to Work, where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. With an ambitious goal of delivering 20 new medicines by 2030, there is no better place to make a difference in medicine, for patients, and in society.

**Why AstraZeneca #EAI**

At AstraZeneca, we're driven by purpose — becoming digitally-enabled to drive better outcomes for patients. In this role, you'll be the one making that change happen, partnering across functions to ensure our people and organisation successfully adopt new ways of working. You'll join a truly enterprise-wide effort that breaks down silos and unites diverse teams, with the freedom to take smart risks and shape how transformation lands across the business.

Recognizing the importance of individualized flexibility, our ways of working allow employees to balance personal and work commitments while ensuring we continue to create a strong culture of collaboration and teamwork by **engaging face-to-face in our offices 3 days a week**. Our head office is purposely designed with collaboration in mind, providing space where teams can come together to strategize, brainstorm and connect on key projects.

**About the Role**

Enterprise Data Enablement (EDE) is AstraZeneca’s enterprise capability for enabling trusted, connected and reusable data across the organisation. Working with Business Technology Group (BTG) IT teams, SET Area Data Offices (SEDEs) and data delivery teams, EDE brings together data strategy, architecture, governance, platforms and delivery to support Data Mesh-aligned data products, analytical solutions and AI-ready data. The Enterprise AI (EAI) vision depends on this foundation: semantic modelling provides the governed meaning and context that let AI consistently understand and connect data across Commercial and the wider enterprise.

Our global Enterprise Information Architecture (EIA) Practice works within EDE, specializing in Enterprise Information Architecture, Information Architecture, Data Modelling and Data Analysis. We design the key aspects of the data world for AstraZeneca across our global customer businesses, offering critical services focused upon the ingestion, extraction, processing, transformation, transport, storage and representation of knowledge, analysis and modelling of our essential data and facts. We use leading thinking, processes, and methods to achieve enduring outcomes for projects and business-as-usual working, and lead on enterprise-level, cross organizational information architecture, for example around the definition and delivery of Data Products and alignment with Data Mesh, Data Platforms, FAIR and TRUST Data thinking across our businesses.

The EIA practice is seeking an Information Architect aligned to Commercial IT. Working with Senior Information Architects and the Head/Lead of Information Architecture Commercial, the role will contribute to the definition and governance of information architectures, ontologies, semantic models and metadata standards across Commercial IT and one or more projects/programmes. A key focus is the Commercial ontology portfolio in Metaphactory: the Commercial Conceptual Domain Ontology for Market and Sell and the application ontologies underpinning data products for programmes such as Customer 2030, Future CRM, One Data Foundation and Commercial AI. The EIA Commercial team partners across all the Commercial global functions including (not exhaustive) Marketing, Medical, Commercial Excellence, Patient and Market Access across the markets. The role will also support the definition of enterprise Data Strategies which may include information and data, regulatory or technical governances in a Data Mesh architecture, data innovation, enterprise architectures, governance policies, standards and procedures.**This is a hybrid role located in Wilmington, DE. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of the office or be willing to relocate for this opportunity.**

**What You'll Do:****Enterprise Information Architecture Accountabilities:**

* Responsible for delivering coherent tactical, and contributing to strategic, architectural thinking across information and data architectures, MRDM, data strategies, ontology and semantic modelling, and information and data governances.

* Responsible for working within the Enterprise Data Architecture Framework, applying and extending leading practices, models (conceptual, logical, physical, semantic), standards, frameworks, and the overall Blueprint for a project.

* Build and maintain Commercial ontologies, taxonomies and controlled vocabularies in line with the EIA Ontology Framework and Playbook, including supporting the migration of legacy ER/Studio models into governed Metaphactory ontologies.

* Support the Head/Lead of Information Architecture Commercial and Senior Information Architects in developing and applying strategy and best practice for Information Architecture, in partnership with the AstraZeneca business functions, solution developments and functional projects.

* Support architecture and technology evangelization, architecture roadmap, and alignment within assigned Commercial projects.

* Contribute to architecture, leading practice, and technology education, including ontology and semantic literacy.

* Contribute to Architectural Governance, including preparing Architectural Decisions and progressing work to appropriate governance and assurance forums (e.g. EIAAB), boards and councils.

**Commercial Information Architecture aligned Accountabilities:**

* Deliver Information Architecture (IA), conceptual, logical and semantic models, for operational, master and data products including data models, information flows, master/reference data, ontology and metadata designs to meet Business Capability requirements.

* Work with business and IT stakeholders to evolve IA and semantic designs to support business strategy.

* Own the IA designs and application ontologies for assigned data products or Business capability areas, reusing the Commercial Conceptual Domain Ontology.

* Provide IA for projects within Commercial IT, escalating enterprise-level design decisions to Senior Information Architects.

* Assure IT change projects are aligned to IA through either delivering IA blueprint artefacts or reviewing designs from Data Modellers/Solution Architects assigned to the project, including ontology conformance.

* Work with the Commercial Data Office to ensure data governance processes are enabled in IA designs and provide assurance evidence through standardised metrics: e.g., master data consumption, data classification metadata application to support access processes, ontology adoption.

* Select and apply the correct architecture and patterns to fulfill traditional reporting (management information, business intelligence) and analytics, data science, digital, operational and AI business use cases, with attention to AI-readiness.

This includes:

* Providing tactical data architecture planning, design expertise and execution application on development projects, from technical designs and technology standards to Models and IA considerations.
* Contributing coherent architectural thinking in support of data and other strategies, enterprise data and information architectures, and knowledge-graph enabled use cases.
* Support the development of Data Integration architecture and overall Data Integration design of a project, grounded in canonical and semantic reference models.
* Gains approval for the various IA artifacts ensuring enforcement of standard enterprise data element names, abbreviations, characteristics, and domains during the lifecycle of a project.

**Education, Qualifications, Skills and Experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent number of years of experience in a Computer Science, Data Management or related field.

* Experience in delivering enterprise data platform and information architectural thinking, and its practical application.

* Experience in the use of conceptual, logical and semantic data modelling technologies, including ontology or taxonomy design.

* Experience of working with information and data regulatory governances (e.g. privacy, consent, data ethics).

* The role holder will possess a blend of data/information architecture, analysis, and engineering skills.

* Experience in known industry IT architectural patterns and IT architecture ways of working/methodologies (e.g. FAIR data principles, TRUST, Data Mesh).

* Understanding of ontologies, semantic layers and knowledge graphs, and how they enable interoperable, AI-ready data.

* Understanding the appropriate data structure and technology based on business use case and completely familiar with data lifecycles.

**Desirable**

* Post-graduate degree in MIS, Data Management, Knowledge Engineering or equivalent domain.

* Experience in a data or information architect role with practical examples of designing and providing architectural blueprints that have been implemented.

* Experience of Information and Data Governance frameworks and their application in a Commercial IT organisation

* Understands Data Platforms concepts and cloud-based containerization strategies for hybrid cloud environments.

* Experience in Agile data definition scrums.

* Experience in the use of tooling, e.g. metadata cataloguing (Collibra), data modelling (ER/Studio), ontology tools and standards (Metaphactory, OWL, RDF, SKOS, SHACL), EA tools.

* Understanding of, or familiarity with, Data Mesh approaches (as distinct from Data Fabric or Data Platform).

* Familiarity with Commercial data standards and sources (e.g. IDMP, HCP/HCO master data, CRM, claims and syndicated data).

* Experience working in matrix-based environment with multiple stakeholder groups identifying priorities.

* Experience of working in the Pharmaceutical industry and of at least one Commercial function, e.g. Marketing, Customer Engagement, Commercial Excellence, Market Access.

* Interest in contributing to semantic modelling communities of practice and training.
