Title: MNOC West Lead
Description:
The
**Network Operations Center (NOC) Lead**
provides senior operational leadership, technical oversight, and strategic direction for a mission-critical Network/Mission Network Operations Center supporting 24x7 operations. The NOC Lead is responsible for ensuring the
**security, availability, reliability, readiness, and efficient operation**
of network and IT services supporting the MSC fleet.
  
  
This position supervises and directs a multidisciplinary team operating around the clock, establishes operational priorities, monitors compliance with contractual and performance requirements, and coordinates incident response and service restoration. The NOC Lead works closely with government customers, program leadership, technical teams, and the NOC East location to maintain consistent operational standards and ensure mission readiness.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong technical knowledge with proven leadership, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills and will be capable of managing personnel and operations in a high-tempo, mission-critical environment.
  
  
**Location:**
Wahiawa, HI
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Work Arrangement:**
On-Site
  
  
**Security Clearance:**
Active Top Secret Clearance Required
  
  
**Certification:**
DoD IAT Level III or equivalent
  
  
**Experience:**
8+ years IT experience; 3+ years recent leadership/supervisory experience
  
  
**Education:**
High School Diploma or Equivalent
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
**NOC Operations & Mission Readiness**

* Provide overall operational leadership for the NOC and ensure effective 24x7x365 monitoring and support of mission-critical services.
* Supervise and manage a team consisting of nine on-site Watch Operators supporting 24x7 operations and six Subject Matter Experts supporting Monday–Friday operations.
* Establish operational priorities and ensure adequate staffing, coverage, and workload distribution.
* Ensure systems, hardware, configurations, and data flows remain operational, secure, and in a hot-standby/readiness posture to support MSC fleet requirements.
* Monitor operational performance and ensure services are delivered in accordance with established Performance Work Standards (PWS), task requirements, procedures, and contractual obligations.
* Identify operational risks and develop mitigation strategies to maintain service availability and mission continuity.
* Provide after-hours and surge support when required by mission or operational conditions.

**Personnel Leadership & Management**

* Provide day-to-day leadership, direction, and technical guidance to NOC personnel.
* Manage staffing, schedules, workload assignments, and operational coverage.
* Review and approve employee timesheets and ensure accurate reporting of labor and project activities.
* Conduct performance reviews, provide coaching and feedback, and administer formal counseling when appropriate.
* Identify personnel development and training requirements and promote professional growth.
* Foster a professional, collaborative, safety-conscious, and mission-focused work environment.
* Ensure personnel comply with applicable company, government, security, safety, and operational requirements.

**Operational Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Conduct routine and detailed reviews of operational tracking tools to ensure information is current, accurate, complete, and actionable.
* Monitor accomplishment of Performance Work Standards, task lists, operational requirements, and project deliverables.
* Maintain operational documentation, reports, logs, metrics, and records necessary to demonstrate compliance and performance.
* Identify deficiencies, recurring issues, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Develop and implement corrective actions when operational or performance requirements are not being met.
* Ensure consistent procedures and operational standards are maintained across NOC locations.

**Incident Management & Service Restoration**

* Oversee the response, tracking, escalation, and resolution of incident and trouble-call tickets.
* Ensure incidents are prioritized appropriately based on mission impact and restored as efficiently as possible.
* Coordinate with technical teams, government personnel, and other stakeholders during significant incidents and outages.
* Monitor recurring incidents and recommend corrective or preventive actions.
* Ensure accurate and timely ticket documentation, escalation, resolution, and closure.
* Support root-cause analysis and after-action reviews for significant operational events.

* Maintain close coordination with NOC East in Pensacola, Florida, ensuring consistent operational practices, procedures, and service delivery.
* Participate in cross-site planning, staffing coordination, technical discussions, and operational reviews.
* Facilitate communication and knowledge sharing between NOC locations and technical teams.
* Support standardization of procedures, reporting, monitoring, and operational processes across sites.
* Coordinate with corporate leadership and program management on organizational initiatives and operational requirements.

**Program & Project Support**

* Perform assigned Project Manager and Operations Manager responsibilities in coordination with the MNOC Lead.
* Serve as a liaison between site personnel, program leadership, corporate management, and government stakeholders.
* Support implementation of corporate directives, program initiatives, process changes, and infrastructure improvements.
* Evaluate operational requirements and submit recommendations or proposals for infrastructure, process, and service improvements.
* Track assigned projects, action items, deliverables, and milestones through completion.
* Provide management with status updates, operational metrics, risks, and recommendations.

**Security & Infrastructure**

* Ensure NOC hardware, configurations, systems, and data flows comply with applicable security policies, technical standards, and established procedures.
* Maintain systems in a secure and operationally ready condition.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity and technical personnel to address vulnerabilities, security concerns, configuration issues, and operational risks.
* Ensure personnel follow applicable security requirements when handling systems, data, equipment, and classified information.
* Support security inspections, assessments, audits, and corrective-action activities as required.

* Ensure facility upkeep, cleanliness, and appropriate working conditions.
* Monitor site safety requirements and promptly address safety concerns.
* Ensure adequate supplies, equipment, and materials are available to support operations.
* Submit timely purchase orders and supply requests in accordance with established company procedures.
* Implement and manage the applicable Inclement Weather Plan when required.
* Maintain accountability for personnel safety during normal and emergency operations.

* Prepare and submit operational reports, status updates, metrics, and performance information to leadership and government stakeholders as required.
* Communicate significant incidents, operational risks, staffing concerns, and service-impacting conditions promptly.
* Maintain effective communication with personnel across all shifts.
* Conduct or participate in operational meetings, briefings, reviews, and planning sessions.
* Ensure accurate turnover between shifts and effective communication of outstanding issues and priorities.

* 8+ years of IT experience , with at least 3 years of recent leadership or supervisory experience.
* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience leading IT, NOC, network operations, systems administration, or mission operations personnel.
* Experience managing teams supporting 24x7x365 operations.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, network operations, incident management, and service availability.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a high-tempo, mission-critical environment.
* Experience with operational tracking, reporting, compliance monitoring, and performance metrics.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with government customers, technical teams, management, and geographically dispersed personnel.
* Ability to provide leadership during outages, emergencies, surge operations, and other high-priority events.
* Ability to travel periodically to corporate headquarters in Virginia and NOC East in Pensacola, Florida.
* Active Top Secret security clearance required.

**Certification Requirements**

* DoD IAT Level III certification or equivalent , in accordance with applicable DoD cybersecurity requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Prior experience supporting Department of Defense or U.S. Navy programs.
* Experience supporting a Network Operations Center, Mission Network Operations Center, Command Center, or similar 24x7 operational environment.
* Experience with DoD network operations, cybersecurity, communications, or enterprise infrastructure.
* Experience managing geographically dispersed or cross-site technical teams.
* Experience with IT service management (ITSM), incident management, and ticketing systems.
* Experience developing operational procedures, performance metrics, SOPs, and process-improvement initiatives.
* Prior military communications, network operations, information technology, or technical leadership experience is highly desirable.

**Work Location & Travel**
This is a
**fully on-site position in Wahiawa, Hawaii**
. This position is
**not remote or hybrid**
, and the selected candidate is expected to report to the facility daily, Monday through Friday, while providing leadership and oversight of 24x7 operations.
  
  
**Some travel may be required**
to the company's headquarters in Virginia and to NOC East in Pensacola, Florida, for meetings, training, operational coordination, or other mission requirements.

============

**Job Description:**

Grata is the leading private market dealmaking platform. We make it easy to find, research, and engage with private companies while powering end-to-end **M&A business development workflows**. Our platform delivers the most comprehensive, accurate, and searchable proprietary data on private companies, their financials, and their owners.

This role sits at the intersection of large-scale data engineering, entity resolution, and search, and is accountable for the coverage, accuracy, and freshness of the firmographic, financial, and ownership data at the core of the platform.

  + Kafka, Pulsar, or similar event streaming platforms
  + Airflow, dbt, or workflow orchestration tools

* Exposure to cloud-native architectures and scalable backend services.
* Experience working in private market intelligence, firmographics, or other data-product domains.

* Anticipating cross-team constraints and balancing technical risk with delivery goals.
* Holding teams to a high data-quality bar while reinforcing sustainable execution.

* Communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical partners.
* Guiding teams through architectural evolution and platform upgrades.
* Proactively improving processes, metrics, and engineering effectiveness.

Title: Business Operations Manager
Description:
**Business Operations Manager**

*• Business Development • Dubai, UAE • Justlife*

Right now, thousands of people in the UAE book a cleaner through Justlife and expect them to show up on time, do excellent work, and leave their home better than they found it. That promise only holds if the cleaners are there, trained, motivated, and routed efficiently — which means someone has to own the daily operating reality of that supply chain: keeping cleaners deployed, partners accountable, costs disciplined, and quality high.

This is an operations role, not a strategy role. You'll run the DTC home cleaning business end-to-end — 300+ cleaners across multiple partner companies, a small on-ground team of account executives and roster agents, and **measurable improvement in on-time performance, completion rates, and contribution margin within your first six months**. Every day you'll make decisions that move the numbers: which partner hires next, how to incentivise productivity, where fuel and routing waste money, whether we're hitting our supply plan. This is what it means to own a real business line.

**You'll love this role if you...**

* You think in unit economics and get frustrated when a cost lever stays hidden in a spreadsheet instead of being fixed
* You've run a large field or blue-collar workforce (directly or through partners) and know exactly how to hold external teams accountable without being their boss
* You're energised by problems you can see and touch — you'd rather spend an hour in a van or at a partner accommodation than sit in a meeting
* You build teams that work without you, and you actively coach people into bigger roles
* You obsess over data quality because you know bad reports kill decisions, and you'll learn SQL or Power BI yourself rather than wait for someone to build your dashboard

**What you'll own**

* **Drive sustained improvement in on-time %, completion rate %, promise-kept %, and absent rate %** by building daily operating discipline — reviewing metrics with the team each morning, identifying blockers, and acting on them before they compound into service failures.
* Lead and develop the on-ground operations team (2 account executives and 4 remote roster agents): set clear priorities, review performance daily, coach individuals toward higher capability, and manage accountability.
* Own supply planning and growth: forecast cleaner headcount needed against demand by city and partner, manage onboarding pace and allocation across partner companies, and reduce time-to-deployment so new hires contribute faster.
* Manage partner companies as senior counterparts: run monthly business reviews, hold them to service-level agreements and commercial terms, reconcile statements of account with finance monthly, and escalate issues before they become crises.
* Design and drive cost and process projects that improve contribution margin — incentive structure redesigns, fuel and fleet controls, van routing optimisation, cleaner orientation and training — taking each from idea to measurable result.
* Build and maintain reporting that surfaces what's driving performance: which partners are slipping, where attrition is highest, which cost levers moved margin, what's blocking supply. Act on what it shows.
* Spend meaningful time in the field — in vans, accommodations, and partner sites — so you understand problems first-hand and your team sees you do the same.

**What tells us you're the one**

* You've **measurably improved operational metrics across a large field workforce** — *tell us a specific program you ran (incentive redesign, routing optimisation, vendor onboarding, training rollout, etc.) and the metric that moved as a result: completion rate up X%, on-time performance improved Y%, attrition fell Z%, or margin lifted by N%*.
* You can spot cause and effect: when a metric moves, you know whether it's partner execution, process design, incentive misalignment, or something else — and you know how to test your hypothesis before rolling out a fix.
* You've managed blue-collar, field-based, or logistics workforces (home services, facilities management, staffing, last-mile delivery, quick commerce) — or run marketplace operations where supply quality depends on external partners. Results matter far more than years, but 5–7 years of this kind of work is the sweet spot.
* You're fluent in data: you can build operating reports independently, interrogate a spreadsheet without help, and use SQL, Power BI, or AI tools to automate manual reporting so you have time to think.
* You speak fluent English, written and spoken. Bonus: you speak languages common to the workforce in the UAE (Tagalog, Urdu, Arabic), or you have prior experience operating in the UAE market in home services, logistics, or staffing.

**Why Justlife**

* **Scale and impact:** You'll run a real, revenue-generating business line serving thousands of customers across the UAE, managing hundreds of cleaners and multiple partner companies, with direct line of sight from your decisions to customer satisfaction and margin.
* **Clear growth path:** this role is a launchpad into broader category leadership, multi-city operations, or general management as we scale across the GCC.
* **Close partnership with leadership:** you'll work alongside the Business Development lead and the founding team, with real influence on strategy and resource decisions.
* **A fair, performance-driven culture:** you'll be measured on the metrics you own, recognised through our JustHeroes program, and rewarded for results — not politics.
* **Startup benefits:** a birthday day off (JustHoliday), free Justlife service credits, referral bonuses, and regular team experiences.

***Join the tribe and let's become #everydaybetter, together.***

Title: Program Manager - Linehaul ACES, ACES TREX
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At Amazon, our businesses continue to grow and expand because of our innovative technologies, extensive global retail selection, and world class operations. Driving all of our businesses are talented employees who are strong owners, have the highest standards, and obsess over our customers.
  
  
Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) drives operational excellence across the Middle East, Africa, and Turkey region. The MEATR Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) is looking for a strong Program Manager to lead the Linehaul ACES cost & productivity charter, you will own programs that improve operational efficiency improving productivity and driving down cost structure across the linehaul network, including truck utilization (TU%), trip planning, while partnering with linehaul operations and cross-functional teams to solve joint problems and implement solutions.  
  
A successful candidate must have a proven ability to execute both strategically and tactically with a solid technical background. The candidate must also demonstrate an ability to influence across global teams and a passion for building data-driven programs to improve business operations.
  
  
General core responsibilities and expectations include:
  

* Leadership – Develop a global roadmap to deliver employee file compliance initiatives, including resource planning, metrics/reporting mechanisms, and operational goals.

- Deliver Solutions - Design and implement new or modified processes to drive employee file compliance; drives continuous improvement projects to optimize operations.  
- Tech Management - Partners with tech team to develop new solutions to automate business processes, establish technical process controls, and eliminate compliance risk.  
- Communication - Communicate complex analysis and insights to stakeholders and senior business leaders, both verbally and in writing.
  
- Project Management - Drives continuous improvement projects to optimize operations and improve productivity; collaborate effectively across teams to define strategy, goals and commitment to timelines and deliverables.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own end-to-end delivery of Linehaul improvement programs, from problem definition and root cause analysis to launch and sustained results.
* Define, track, and report network KPIs such as TU%, cost per trip, on-time departure/arrival, dwell time, and defect rates, using dashboards and ad hoc analysis.
* Lead OP2 and Q-planning inputs for Linehaul, including baselines, targets, and savings tracking.
* Run ACES mechanisms: weekly business reviews, action trackers, deep dives, and escalations.
* Partner with Transportation Ops, Planning, Finance, Carrier Management, and AMZL/ATS leadership to align priorities and remove blockers.
* Benchmark performance across countries and sites, and scale best practices.
* Drive process standardization, SOP creation, and change management across sites.
* Produce clear written narratives and executive-ready updates (briefs, 6-pagers, decks).

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

Title: Program Manager
Description:
**Correlation One develops workforce skills for the AI economy**

Enterprises and governments work with us to develop talent and close critical data, digital, and technology skills gaps. Our global programs, including training programs and data competitions, also empower underrepresented communities and accelerate careers.

Our mission is to create equal access to the data-driven jobs of the future. We partner with top employers and government organizations to make that a reality, including Amazon, Coca-Cola, Johnson & Johnson, the U.S. State Department, and the U.S. Department of Defense.

Our skills training programs are 100% free for learners and are delivered virtually by industry experts to minimize traditional barriers to career advancement. We take pride in fostering supportive, human-led, group learning environments that build technical proficiency and confidence in participants.

Join us and let's shape the AI Economy together!

**Your Impact:**

As Program Manager (PM) at Correlation One, you will contribute to the success of our live, online training programs by managing key aspects of program delivery and supporting the Program Operations team in strategic initiatives. You will play a crucial role in the preparation, launch, and ongoing management of training programs, ensuring effective collaboration across teams and exceptional customer service.

The ideal candidate is an excellent project and program manager and is able to execute simultaneous competing deadlines and tasks involving multiple stakeholders. This role will support the preparation and launch of Correlation One training programs, including application setup and management, instructional staff hiring, cross-functional team collaboration, and client communication.

Reporting to a Senior Program Manager, this position requires a motivated individual with program management experience. A successful PM is a quick learner with a strong work ethic who takes initiative and is able to navigate ambiguity productively and patiently. They have an interest in changing lives through education and a desire to work on larger and/or different programs as we continue to scale. Correlation One is a company where creativity, initiative, collaboration, and communication are valued.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Program Management**

* Assist in the preparation and launch of training programs, handling application setup, client communications, and managing instructional staff hiring processes.
* Oversee multiple programs simultaneously, managing project timelines and ensuring seamless execution.
* Support the Senior Operations Team in developing and implementing strategic initiatives to enhance program impact, experience, and scalability.
* Facilitate a successful admissions process, which includes application setup and launch, applicant pipeline monitoring and reporting, and marketing initiatives, Q&A sessions, and/or any necessary applicant support to ensure strong enrollment.
* Manage the instructional contractor screening, review, and hiring processes for Teaching Assistants and Lead Instructors.
* Manage the live, online training programs (typically 12-20 weeks in length), ensuring learners, teaching assistants, instructors, and other stakeholders engage and benefit from the program.
* Monitor learners' progress in the course while providing support for instructors and other contractual staff.
* Ensure stakeholders are fulfilling their role's responsibilities and course technology is functioning appropriately.
* Create a friendly, professional learning environment by troubleshooting learner needs and responding to all inquiries in a timely, professional manner.

* **Admissions Process:**

* Contribute to a successful admissions process, including application setup, monitoring applicant pipelines, responding to Zendesk inquiries, and participating in marketing initiatives.
* Work collaboratively with the Senior Program Manager on Q&A sessions and applicant support to ensure strong enrollment.

* **Team Leadership and Development:**

* Manage and provide guidance to a small team of 1-2 Operations Analysts.
* Foster a collaborative and innovative team culture, encouraging continuous learning and development.
* Provide ongoing feedback, career development, and mentorship to team members.

* **Client Relationship Management:**

* Support the Senior Program Manager in cultivating and strengthening relationships with clients, ensuring their unique needs are met.
* Collaborate with the Senior Program Manager to address client concerns and identify opportunities for program enhancements.

* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**

* Collaborate with various teams, including Business Operations, Curriculum, Professional Development, Account Management, and others, to ensure coordinated program execution.
* Provide input to drive improvements in the overall training program ecosystem.

* **Strategic Insight and Reporting:**

* Contribute to the analysis of program performance metrics and provide insights to senior leadership.
* Assist in reporting on program developments, successes, and challenges, contributing to data-driven decision-making processes.

* **Continuous Improvement:**

* Identify opportunities for process optimization and innovation, driving continuous improvement in program delivery and experience.
* Implement best practices and lessons learned from previous programs to enhance overall effectiveness.

**Your Expertise:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred; Master's degree in a relevant field is a plus.
* 3-5 years of experience in program management, with at least 1 directly in an educational or training institution.
* Experience leading and managing teams, demonstrating autonomy and success.
* Proficient in Google Suite, MS Office Suite, Slack, and Zoom.
* Experience with Data analysis, CRM or Salesforce, and other education-related software is a plus.

**Time Commitment:**

* While we provide a lot of flexibility as a remote-first organization, and given the general needs of the training operations team, the guide for working hours align to the East Coast (Monday - Friday, 9AM - 6PM ET)
* Given the nature of adult learners, occasional work on Saturdays is required. Compensatory time off is provided for this work.

**Location:**

* Due to upcoming program geography, our strong preference for this Program Manager's location is Canada.

**How we support our people**

* Insurance or subsidies based on country
* Unlimited Time Off, with a minimum time off recommendation
* Company-paid holidays
* Official company-wide holiday for the last week of the calendar year
* Access to free data skills training through our programs
* A company culture that empowers individuals and embraces diversity through its core mission

The compensation range for this position is specific to location and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. These factors include (but are not limited to) location, experience, education and skill sets. A reasonable estimate of the annual salary for this role is $92,000 - $107,000 CAD.

We encourage applicants to bring their unique skills, experiences, and outlook to our work environment.

Correlation One is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. Title: Manager, Business Operations Analyst
Description:
About Beanfield

  

We don’t just build networks, we build communities. From our roots in Liberty Village to our growing footprint across Toronto, Montreal, and Vancouver, Beanfield has spent 35+ years connecting people through a robust, independently owned fibre-optic network.

  

With 500+ employees and an entrepreneurial mindset, we move fast, think creatively, and stay connected to the people who make Beanfield what it is. If you thrive in a collaborative, high-impact environment where your work matters, you will feel right at home.

  

Our headquarters is located in Toronto’s super-hip Liberty Village, surrounded by great coffee, food, energy, and creativity—making it a great place to collaborate in person.

  

Our Values

  

We Are Challengers
  
  
  
We lead the way. We disrupt the industry by thinking differently, moving quickly, and taking ownership. We operate with a startup mentality and believe in building and investing in our own infrastructure, and our people.

  

We Are United
  
  
  
We operate as one team. Collaboration is core to how we work, and every idea matters. We believe strong partnerships and shared ownership lead to better outcomes.

  

We Care
  
  
  
We care deeply about our employees, partners, customers, and communities. We build trust through open communication, thoughtful decisions, and a relentless focus on our brand and customer experience.

  

The Role

  

Beanfield is looking for a hands-on Manager, Business Operations Analyst to lead our growing team of Business Operations while actively driving high-impact technical and operational initiatives. Reporting directly to the Director, Business Operations, you will play a pivotal role in scaling how we work.

  

In this "player-coach" role, you will divide your time between mentoring direct reports, standardizing how our BA practice operates, and acting as the lead Business Analyst for major enterprise initiatives—most notably our upcoming ServiceNow implementation and broader system rollouts. You will bridge the gap between cross-functional business units and technical teams to ensure our processes are scalable, documented, and aligned with Beanfield’s growth.

  
  

What’s in it for you

  

  
* A united, values-driven culture that genuinely cares about people, collaboration, and community.
  
* A comprehensive total rewards package, including Traditional Spending Account (TSA) and Health Care Spending Account (HCSA) coverage to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  
* An additional five (5) personal care days, giving you extra flexibility to recharge, reset, or take care of what matters most.
  
* Hybrid work policy - 3 days a week
  

  
  

What You’ll Do

  

Leadership & Practice Standardization

  

  
* Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Business Analysts, conducting regular 1-on-1s, workload balancing, and performance reviews.
  
* Process & Documentation Alignment: Establish, standardize, and enforce consistent BA methodologies, templates, and documentation standards (BRDs, process flows, user stories) across the entire team.

* Identify, track, and mitigate risks and blockers before they impact delivery.
* Manage vendor and partner relationships through scope changes, timeline conflicts, and commercial negotiations
* Maintain clear program documentation: decisions logs, status reports, shared technical information.
* Hold work stream leads and engineers accountable to commitments without direct line authority.
* Escalate effectively and concisely when decisions need senior input.
* Continuously improve delivery processes, tooling, and ways of working across the program.

* Broad engineering background with some technical experience across hardware, software and manufacturing.
* 3+ years in a TPM, program management, or senior project management role in a technical environment.
* Proven track record delivering multi-disciplinary programs at scale with multiple interdependent teams.
* Strong engineering literacy: able to engage credibly on technical trade-offs without being the domain expert.
* Strong stakeholder management up to VP; comfortable holding people to account
* Fluent in program management best practices.
* Structured thinker with high attention to detail and an ability to bring clarity to an otherwise high-ambiguity development environment.
* Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments.

Title: Head of Project Execution, C&I Energy
Description:
**About The Role**

We are looking for an experienced Head of Project Execution to lead project execution for Yellow Door Energy's commercial and industrial (C&I) portfolio across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman and Qatar. The role will ideally based in Saudi Arabia but we may consider Dubai.

Reporting to the Group COO, you will lead engineering and project management for our core C&I project portfolio across solar PV, BESS and grid-connected energy solutions. Your accountability will run from pre-construction design through construction and commissioning to handover to Operations & Maintenance. You will make sure projects are technically robust, safely delivered, commercially disciplined and aligned with approved investment assumptions.

This is a senior leadership role that operates at both strategic and technical level. It suits someone who combines proven C&I execution leadership with deep technical knowledge of solar PV, BESS, electrical infrastructure and grid connection. You will build and lead a high-performing regional team and set the standards, governance and ways of working that shape how YDE engineers and delivers its projects.

**What You'll Deliver & Own**

**Team and execution leadership**

* Lead and develop the regional Execution team across engineering and project management, setting clear priorities, standards and accountabilities aligned with Group and country objectives.
* Build team capability through coaching, performance management, succession planning and recruitment as the portfolio grows.
* Lead senior engagement with clients, EPC contractors, consultants, suppliers and delivery partners, resolving material technical and execution issues.
* Work closely with Development, Commercial, Technical, Procurement and PMO, Finance, Legal, O&M and QHSSE to ensure execution requirements are reflected in project decisions and commitments.
* Embed consistent project governance, reporting, lessons learned and continuous improvement across the regional portfolio.

**Engineering, grid and pre-construction assurance**

* Provide technical leadership across pre-construction and detailed engineering, including design reviews, constructability, site suitability and optimisation.
* Lead or oversee technical negotiations with clients and EPC contractors, ensuring technical requirements are properly reflected in tender packages, EPC agreements and technical appendices. Support commercial negotiations where needed.
* Oversee grid connection and Grid Code compliance across LV, MV and HV systems, including SEC, SERA and SASO requirements and other applicable standards.
* Guide major equipment specification and selection, covering PV modules, inverters, BESS, transformers, switchgear, protection, cables, tracking systems and monitoring solutions.
* Ensure energy yield and performance assessments, including P50/P90 analysis and uncertainty evaluation, are robust and correctly reflected in project assumptions.

**Project delivery, construction and handover**

* Oversee delivery against investment committee-approved scope, budget, schedule and technical assumptions, intervening early where risk or variance emerges.
* Direct contractor and supplier performance, including technical coordination, design implementation, site progress, issue resolution and change management.
* Ensure effective QA/QC across factory acceptance testing, site inspections, mechanical completion, commissioning, PAC, FAC and end-of-warranty activities.
* Ensure as-built documentation, testing records, punch-list closure and handover requirements are complete for transition to O&M.
* Promote strong QHSSE performance and visible safety leadership across all execution activities.

**What You Must Bring**

* A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
* 10+ years' relevant experience in solar PV, renewable energy or power infrastructure, including at least 5 years in a senior management or leadership role within technical consulting, EPC, project execution, engineering or asset management.
* A track record of leading multidisciplinary engineering and project delivery teams across development, construction, commissioning and handover.
* Substantial experience in EPC contracting and negotiation, contractor management, technical due diligence and delivery governance for complex energy projects.
* Deep technical understanding of solar PV, BESS, grid connection and LV/MV/HV electrical infrastructure, including protection and major equipment selection.
* Sound knowledge of GCC grid and regulatory requirements, including experience working with local utilities and applicable Grid Codes.
* Commercial and contractual judgement to resolve complex technical, contractual and delivery issues.
* Experience working effectively in a multinational, matrix environment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.

**Strong Advantage**

* Registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE).
* Hands-on familiarity with PVsyst and related design or simulation tools such as SolarGIS, AutoCAD, SketchUp, PVcase or HOMER.
* Experience across C&I, hybrid and/or utility-scale renewable energy projects.
* Exposure to M&A, project acquisition or technical due diligence.

**You'll Thrive Here If...**

* You are equally comfortable in leadership discussions and in a detailed design or grid review.
* You can challenge designs, assumptions and delivery approaches while keeping relationships constructive.
* You build teams with clear expectations and accountability, and you invest in developing people.
* You spot execution risks early and resolve them with sound technical and commercial judgement.
* You look for ways to raise standards, strengthen governance and turn lessons learned into better delivery across a growing portfolio.

**Why Join Us?**

You will lead the execution of C&I renewable energy projects across four markets, working across solar PV, BESS and increasingly complex grid-connected energy solutions.

The role offers real influence over how YDE's projects are engineered and delivered. You will build the regional team, set delivery standards and work closely with YDE's regional leadership and Development, Commercial, Technical, Finance, Legal and Operations teams.

**About Yellow Door Energy**

Yellow Door Energy is the leading sustainable energy partner for commercial and industrial businesses across the Middle East and Africa. We deliver sustainable energy solutions through power purchase agreements and solar leases, helping businesses reduce energy costs, improve power reliability and lower carbon emissions.

Our solutions include solar PV, battery energy storage systems, hybrid energy and energy efficiency. Our shareholders include Actis, Mitsui & Co, TAEF and the International Finance Corporation.

**Apply Now!**

If you are an experienced renewable energy execution leader with deep technical knowledge of solar PV, BESS and grid-connected systems, and a track record of building teams that deliver safe, high-quality projects, we'd love to hear from you.

**Let's lead the charge in sustainable energy solutions together.**

The role owns the integrated transport planning and operational delivery cycle, ensuring transport demand forecasts are translated into effective fleet, driver and route plans and successfully executed through operational teams. The role leads planning analysts, transport supervisors and operational teams to ensure alignment between workforce demand, transport capacity and customer requirements. Through the use of AI-enabled planning tools, transport management systems, telematics, GPS technology and business intelligence platforms, the role establishes a closed-loop performance management process that continuously measures actual performance against planned outcomes, drives operational improvements, improves planning accuracy and delivers sustainable efficiency gains across the transport function.

**Responsibilities:**

**Financial**

* Accountable for the optimization and performance of a transport operation with an annual operating budget.
* Own fleet utilization, resource allocation and service efficiency to maximise value from transport assets and workforce resources.
* Drive route optimization, vehicle productivity and driver utilisation initiatives to reduce operating costs whilst maintaining agreed service levels.
* Lead the identification and delivery of cost reduction, cost avoidance and operational efficiency opportunities across the transport network.
* Establish performance measures and reporting frameworks to monitor transport costs, utilization, productivity and return on fleet investment.

**Customer**

* Accountable for the delivery of safe, reliable and efficient transportation services supporting more than 45,000 daily passenger movements across Transguard operations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external clients to ensure transport services align with operational requirements, workforce deployment plans and contractual commitments.
* Establish customer service standards, performance metrics and service level agreements, ensuring transport performance consistently meets agreed expectations.

* Establish and govern planning standards, operating procedures and performance frameworks across transport operations.
* Accountable for fleet utilization, route efficiency, driver productivity and service performance across the transport network.
* Direct the deployment of vehicles, drivers and operational resources to maximize service reliability and operational efficiency.
* Establish structured performance reviews comparing planned versus actual outcomes and ensure corrective actions are implemented to address variances.
* Lead transport capacity planning, network design and resource planning activities to support future business growth and changing demand.
* Own business continuity, operational resilience and transport risk management frameworks.
* Develop governance processes that create continuous improvement between planning assumptions, operational outcomes and future transport plans.

**Innovation**

* Support the transport planning and delivery transformation roadmap through the adoption of AI-enabled planning, predictive analytics, automation and optimization technologies.

Title: Senior Program Manager
Description:
**About Citco**

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services, delivering end-to-end solutions and service to clients across its global organization.

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Program Manager is accountable for the strategic direction, integrated planning and end-to-end delivery performance of AXI within the Investor Relations Value Stream. In addition to the official Senior Program Manager title, the role fulfils the Value Stream Delivery Lead responsibilities for Investor Relations, ensuring that agreed outcomes and priorities are translated into a coherent roadmap, single governed backlog and measurable delivery plan.

As a member of the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, the role partners with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to connect strategy with execution. The Senior Program Manager owns the overall flow and coordination of delivery, providing clear visibility of progress, capacity, cost, dependencies, risks, impediments and outcomes across AXI and related work.

As a Grade 4 leader, the Senior Program Manager operates with a high degree of autonomy and organizational influence. The role shapes delivery strategy, challenges constructively, resolves complex cross-functional constraints and represents the Value Stream in portfolio and executive forums. The position also includes formal line-management responsibility for staff within the Project Management Department, combining Value Stream delivery accountability with people leadership and capability development.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI Delivery Leadership

* Fulfil the Delivery Lead role within the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, partnering with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to turn agreed outcomes and priorities into executable delivery commitments.

* Own the integrated Investor Relations Value Stream roadmap, AXI program plan, single backlog and delivery performance, ensuring investment and execution remain aligned to agreed strategic objectives and measurable business outcomes.

* Lead a complex portfolio of projects and workstreams, balancing platform development, business change, operational readiness, releases and production priorities.

* Translate strategic direction and business cases into sequenced, achievable delivery plans with clear ownership, dependencies, milestones and success measures.
* Provide direction across cross-functional and globally distributed teams, creating alignment, pace, transparency, and accountability.
* Anticipate material delivery challenges and establish practical mitigation, recovery or escalation strategies before outcomes are affected.
* Act as the senior delivery authority for AXI and the Delivery Lead for the Investor Relations Value Stream, representing delivery in Value Stream, portfolio, executive and governance forums.
* Drive consistent delivery practices, delivery metrics and continuous improvement while allowing teams to apply fit-for-purpose Agile, Waterfall or hybrid methods.
* Coordinate cross-Value Stream demand and dependencies, negotiate sequencing with shared services and escalate priority decisions where demand exceeds available capacity.
* Manage Value Stream capacity, resource demand and allocation, ensuring commitments are realistic and delivery constraints are visible early.
* Lead quarterly planning, roadmap reviews, execution reviews and delivery governance across strategic change, client work, business requests, platform change and KTLO activity.
* Maintain one visible and prioritized backlog linking Value Stream outcomes and objectives to executable epics, stories and delivery commitments, with clear ownership and no orphaned work.
Establish and facilitate the regular Investor Relations Value Stream leadership cadence, ensuring shared ownership across value, delivery, technology and operations.  

**Value Stream Delivery, Flow and Ways of Working**

Integrated Planning, Governance and Financial Control

* Develop and maintain integrated Value Stream plans, roadmaps, budgets, forecasts, capacity and resource plans, and delivery scenarios across AXI and related Investor Relations outcomes.
* Establish proportionate governance across the full delivery lifecycle, including business case, scope, schedule, financials, quality, RAID, decisions, dependencies and benefits.
* Ensure program commitments are realistic and supported by sufficient capacity, funding, technical readiness and business ownership.
* Lead Value Stream prioritization and trade-off discussions where demand exceeds capacity or where scope, sequencing, cost, dependencies or risk require leadership or executive decision.
* Provide concise, evidence-based reporting on delivery confidence, financial position, outcomes and material constraints.
* Ensure program delivery complies with applicable Project Management Department, PMO, SDLC, risk and control requirements

**Technology Delivery and Release Oversight**

* Oversee delivery across the SDLC, ensuring requirements, design, engineering, testing, UAT, performance, release and production-readiness activities are integrated and governed.
* Partner with product, business and technology leadership to maintain alignment between business outcomes, platform priorities and technical execution.
* Coordinate cross-platform, cross-program and cross-Value Stream dependencies, ensuring demand, blockers and integration risks are visible, owned, sequenced and resolved.
* Ensure releases have clear acceptance criteria, quality evidence, operational readiness, communications, implementation and support arrangements.
* Own the health of the Value Stream delivery system, using flow, quality, capacity and financial data to identify bottlenecks, remove impediments, improve predictability and support continuous improvement.
Promote fit-for-purpose use of Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches rather than applying a single methodology by default.  

**Executive and Stakeholder Leadership**

* Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors, business leaders, technology leaders, operations, control functions and external partners.
* Communicate complex delivery matters clearly and directly, adapting detail and recommendations to the audience.
* Present program status, risks, dependencies, investment choices and strategic recommendations to senior governance forums.
* Create a consistent program narrative across stakeholders and ensure decisions, commitments and accountabilities are understood and followed through.
* Challenge constructively where delivery confidence, scope, sequencing, ownership or expected value is unclear.
* Navigate competing priorities and organizational complexity while protecting agreed program outcomes.

**People Leadership and Project Management Capability**

* Provide formal line management for assigned staff within the Project Management Department, including regular one-to-ones, objective setting, performance and development conversations, and support for career growth.
* Set clear expectations for delivery quality, professional conduct, stakeholder management, governance and accountability.
* Allocate and balance work across direct reports, considering program priorities, individual capability, development needs and sustainable workload.
* Coach and mentor project and program management professionals, providing practical guidance on complex delivery situations and supporting sound judgement.
* Identify capability, capacity and succession needs within the team and contribute to recruitment, onboarding, talent development and retention.
* Promote consistent standards, reusable practices and knowledge-sharing across the Project Management Department and relevant communities of practice.
* Create an inclusive, collaborative environment where staff receive timely feedback, understand priorities and are supported to perform effectively.

**Measures of Success**

* Investor Relations Value Stream priorities and AXI investment are translated into one realistic, governed and outcome-focused roadmap and backlog.
* Program commitments are delivered with clear ownership, executive visibility and effective financial control.
* Material risks and dependencies are identified early, with timely decisions and credible mitigation or recovery plans.
* Business, product and technology stakeholders remain aligned on priorities, sequencing, delivery confidence and expected outcomes.
* Releases are delivered with appropriate quality, operational readiness and production support.
* Project Management Department staff have clear objectives, balanced assignments, regular feedback and meaningful development support.
* The Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI delivery teams demonstrate improving flow, predictability, transparency, collaboration and measurable value.

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

Essential

* Extensive experience leading large, complex and strategically important technology programs across multiple projects, workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Demonstrated experience owning delivery execution, flow, planning, capacity, dependencies and governance within a Value Stream, product or comparable cross-functional operating model.
* Proven accountability for end-to-end program delivery, including strategy translation, integrated planning, governance, financial control, risk, dependency, quality and executive reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously, influence senior leaders and make sound decisions in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.
* Strong experience coordinating delivery across business, product, engineering, architecture, testing, operations and control functions.
* Deep understanding of SDLC and delivery methods, including Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches, with the judgement to tailor governance appropriately.
* Proven people-management experience, including objective setting, coaching, performance management, development planning, workload management and recruitment support.
* Experience leading and developing project or program management professionals across distributed teams.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation and influencing capability.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budget management, forecasting, resource planning and investment trade-offs.
* Ability to connect program outputs to business outcomes, adoption and measurable value realization.

Desirable

**Personal Attributes**

* Strategic and outcome-focused, while remaining close enough to execution to intervene effectively.
* Creible and composed with senior stakeholders in complex or high-stakes situations.
* Decisive, pragmatic and willing to make delivery issues visible.
* Strong ownership mindset with high personal accountability.
* Inclusive people leader who sets clear expectations and invests in the development of others.
* Collaborative and able to lead through influence across organizational boundaries.
* Resilient, adaptable and committed to continuous improvement.

**Role Accountabilities**

The Senior Program Manager fulfils the Delivery Lead role for the Investor Relations Value Stream and owns delivery execution, flow, integrated planning, governance, financial control, dependencies and delivery performance for AXI. The Value Lead remains accountable for value, vision and priority decisions; the Technology Lead remains accountable for architecture, engineering quality and technical direction; and the Operations Lead remains accountable for operational input, readiness and adoption. The Senior Program Manager brings these perspectives together into one executable delivery system and is accountable for the effective line management and development of assigned Project Management Department staff.

**Our Benefits**

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

Title: Director of Business Technology
Description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

**TO APPLY**

Qualified candidates are invited to apply directly through this posting.

*Liteline Corporation is an equal opportunity employer that values the unique skills and experiences of every candidate. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities throughout the recruitment and hiring process. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources with the position title in the subject line.*

Pay: $150,000.00 per year

* Disability insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* On-site parking
* RRSP match
* Vision care

* Have you built or significantly developed an IT, business technology, technology governance, or technology enablement function or process from the ground up?
* Do you have hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO, permissions, branch protection or repository governance?
* Do you have hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 environments, including identity, MFA, endpoint management, and security?

**About The Role**
We're looking for a Contact Center Manager to join our Managed Services team and oversee our BPO operations day to day. As Managed Services expands, our BPO engagement is the compliant, reliable entry point for every fintech and credit union client we support. You'll lead our outsourced contact center and back-office investigation teams, manage policies and procedures, optimize IVR routing and call scripts, and turn vendor partnerships into clear results for our clients.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own BPO Performance Day to Day: Serve as the primary operational contact for our contact center vendor(s). Manage SLA adherence, stand up performance reporting, run a regular vendor review cadence, and escalate underperformance with clear evidence and a path to resolution.

* Own Security and Compliance for Phone Intake: Define and monitor controls for phone-based intake, including caller authentication and data handling. Audit the vendor against those controls and drive remediation of any gaps.
* Own Outcomes, Not Just Tickets: Treat recurring vendor or call-quality issues as programs to be solved. Define scope, align internal stakeholders and the vendor, and deliver durable resolutions rather than one-off fixes.
* Be the Bridge to Engineering and Product: Translate contact center and client friction into clear technical requirements and prioritized, business-context-rich input. Advocate for scalable solutions, including tooling integrations and automation.

* Support Client Relationships: Support the Vendor Ops Manager in client-facing work by providing performance data, preparing for business reviews, and connecting vendor results to each client’s operational goals.
* Drive Enablement and Documentation: Build the runbooks, escalation paths, and training materials that make the vendor self-sufficient and prevent repeat issues. Support the implementation team in standing up phone intake for new Managed Services clients.

* Experience managing outsourced or in-house contact center operations at scale, ideally in a regulated industry, with hands-on IVR, WFM, and vendor SLA management.
* Experience in payments, disputes, chargebacks, or Reg E/Z compliance workflows, and familiarity with compliance requirements for phone-based financial services intake.

* Ability to investigate issues independently: reviewing call data and logs, querying data, and identifying root cause before escalating.
* Strong relationship management skills, with the presence to build credibility with vendor leadership and with operational and executive stakeholders at clients.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication: able to make a complex operational or dispute issue clear to both frontline teams and leadership, and to work closely with QA, Product, and vendor partners.

Title: Training Program Manager, Security Operations
Description:
Are you interested in joining an organization with a global reach? In a world of shifting threats, Concentric is your trusted ally. Powered by elite professionals from military, government, and intelligence backgrounds. If you are passionate about intelligence, risk analysis, threat management, executive protection, security operations, or business resiliency, Concentric may be the organization you've been searching for!  
  
Concentric is a risk consultancy specializing in delivering strategic security and intelligence services. We provide holistic, intelligent security solutions for private clients and corporations globally. Concentric offers strategic advisory services, risk assessments, physical protection, threat intelligence, open-source monitoring, program audits, secure embedded staffing, and training for security teams and intelligence analysts.  
  
Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:  
  
Integrity – Collaboration - Relationships – Excellence – Creativity - Results

Join Us,

Concentric - "Your World Secured"

We are currently seeking a Training Program Manager, Security Operations to join Concentric's Corporate Team.

This is a full-time, remote position. Days and hours of work are generally Monday through Friday. Evening and weekend work may be required to support training schedules for agents working varied shifts.

**IS THIS ROLE RIGHT FOR YOU?**

We're looking for an experienced executive protection professional who can both deliver training and run the program behind it.

You'll lead hands-on training for our embedded security teams, and over time for corporate employees. We have established courses in place, so you won't be starting from scratch, but you'll have the ownership to improve them and build new training where we have gaps. When we bring in outside vendors, you'll work alongside them and stay closely involved in delivery.

Just as important is the administrative side. You'll track licenses, certifications, and requalifications in tandem with our compliance team, schedule training around shift coverage and ongoing onboarding, and maintain audit-ready records for every agent. This role requires someone who is highly organized and detail-oriented. Strong instruction alone won't be enough to succeed here.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

The Training Program Manager will deliver, manage, and continuously improve Concentric's training and certification program for Security Operations and physical security embedded positions, including armed and unarmed security personnel, executive protection agents, and residential security teams.

This is Concentric's first dedicated training role, created to support significant growth across our embedded client programs. The Training Program Manager will lead hands-on training for embedded security teams, with the opportunity to extend programs to Concentric's corporate employees. We have established courses, vendors, and a strong network in place, so this role is not a build from scratch. You'll have the ownership to improve existing training and create new courses where gaps exist.

Equally important, this role owns the administration that keeps the program running. You'll work in tandem with our compliance team to track licenses, certifications, and qualifications, schedule training around shift coverage and ongoing onboarding, and maintain complete, audit-ready records for every employee. You'll also serve as the company's subject matter resource on security training compliance, including California Bureau of Security and Investigative Services (BSIS) requirements and other evolving state and international regulations.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Training Delivery & Development*

* Deliver hands-on training to embedded security personnel, with the opportunity to extend programs to Concentric's corporate employees
* Design, schedule, and manage initial and recurring training, including de-escalation, use of force, defensive tactics, First Aid/CPR/AED, Tactical Emergency Casualty Care (TECC), emergency evacuation, fire and water safety, surveillance and surveillance detection, advance work and site assessment, defensive driving, and communications and radio protocol
* Evaluate and improve existing courses, and develop new training where gaps are identified
* Develop and facilitate tabletop exercises and scenario-based training that prepare teams for critical incidents and emergency response
* Source, evaluate, and manage external training vendors, instructors, and ranges, and actively participate in vendor-led training to ensure quality and alignment with Concentric standards
* Coordinate physical fitness standards and testing, swim and water safety qualifications, and other client-required proficiency assessments
* Coordinate continuing education and advanced certification opportunities, such as advanced medical and trauma care, including client-sponsored programs

*Compliance, Tracking & Administration*

* Work in tandem with Concentric's compliance team to track guard registrations, firearms qualifications, firearms permit renewals, and other required licenses and certifications, ensuring renewals and requalifications are completed before expiration
* Verify that new hires have completed required pre-start training and certifications (such as CPR, driving, and licensing requirements), and enroll them in needed courses without delay
* Identify, document, and maintain a training requirements matrix by state, country, license type, position, and client contract, covering initial, annual, and recurring requirements
* Build and lead Concentric's plan to meet current and upcoming California BSIS training requirements for armed and unarmed security personnel, including initial training, annual refresher hours, in-person de-escalation instruction, and employee rights training
* Build and manage training calendars that balance ongoing onboarding, annual training requirements, and shift coverage across multiple client teams
* Translate client contract and work order training mandates into training plans for each client-specific team, and track and report completion against those requirements
* Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready training, certification, and qualification records for each employee throughout employment, and provide documentation to clients upon request
* Partner with People Operations to ensure mandatory training time is properly scheduled, recorded, and compensated, and that training records are maintained in the company's systems of record
* Manage training schedules, logistics, and budget
* Provide regular reporting to leadership and clients on training compliance status, upcoming expirations, and program gaps

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship
* Bachelor's degree in criminal justice, security management, business, education, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* 5+ years of executive protection experience, including 3+ years designing, managing, or delivering training programs; military or law enforcement background preferred
* Experience delivering hands-on security training to adult learners
* Established professional network of training vendors, instructors, ranges, and subject matter experts within the security, law enforcement, or military community
* Working knowledge of security guard licensing and training requirements, including California BSIS requirements
* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining training records, tracking systems, or a learning management system (LMS)
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong program management skills and the ability to manage multiple requirements, deadlines, and stakeholders across locations
* Excellent organizational, written, and verbal communication skills, including presenting to leadership and clients
* Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote environment
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, Monday.com, and spreadsheet-based tracking
* This position requires up to 35% travel, primarily to California and other client locations in the USA and internationally (Ireland, UK), often on short notice. Candidates must live within a reasonable distance of a major airport.
* Periodic work at client sites, training facilities, and firearms ranges is required to deliver, coordinate, or oversee training. This role is largely sedentary when working remotely. When attending or delivering training, the employee may be required to stand for extended periods, move about training areas and firearms ranges, and lift and carry training equipment weighing up to 25 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* BSIS-approved instructor or Firearms Training Instructor certification, or equivalent
* First Aid, CPR, AED Instructor Certification
* TECC/TCCC Instructor Certification
* De-escalation, defensive tactics, or use of force instructor certification
* Executive protection training or certification
* Certified Protection Professional (CPP) or Physical Security Professional (PSP)
* Experience building or formalizing a training program within a growing security organization
* Experience supporting client-embedded security programs with contract-mandated training requirements
* Experience with multi-state security licensing and compliance
* Familiarity with UKG or a similar HRIS platform

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* Medical plan options: Concentric offers two medical plans: a high deductible health plan (HDHP) and a copay plan
* Health Savings Account (HSA): Employees enrolled in the HDHP receive an employer contribution to their HSA, which can be used for eligible medical expenses and carries over year to year
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA): Employees can set aside pre-tax dollars in a medical FSA to cover eligible healthcare expenses
* Paid holidays

* Paid leave (vacation, sick, parental)
* Employer-paid insurance: life, STD, LTD, and AD&D
* 401(k) including employer match
* Pet Insurance
* National discount employee program
* Employee Assistance Program for personal needs
* Credentity Protection – Eclipse Digital Protection by Concentric
* Free access to our Risk Intelligence Dashboard and GEAR App, providing 24/7 access to trusted risk intelligence and remote support, helping you stay informed, prepared, and protected wherever you operate
